Title: Senior Technical Project Manager
Description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Join our team and what we'll accomplish together  
  
At TELUS Health, we're reimagining how pension and benefits solutions are delivered. Our teams are shifting toward a product-led, multi-client delivery model—and we need someone who can bring clarity, momentum, and accountability to complex delivery at scale.  
  
As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you'll be the connective tissue between product vision, engineering execution, and client success. You'll lead high-impact programs across platform enhancements, multi-client deployments, and technical initiatives—all while championing new ways of working that make delivery faster, smarter, and more predictable.  
  
This role offers the unique opportunity to shape how TELUS Health delivers at scale—influencing product roadmaps, release strategies, and team practices that directly impact millions of Canadians and their retirement security.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Lead end-to-end product program delivery**

* Own complex product programs from initiation through post-launch, managing platform enhancements and multi-client deployments with clear outcomes
* Orchestrate release planning, rollout strategies, and delivery milestones that align product roadmaps with client commitments
* Balance multiple concurrent initiatives, dependencies, and competing priorities with discipline and transparency

**Orchestrate cross-functional execution**

* Partner across Product, Engineering, DevOps, QA, Data, Implementation, and delivery teams—acting as the central point of accountability
* Lead governance forums, alignment sessions, and delivery checkpoints that keep teams moving together
* Influence and align stakeholders without direct authority—a critical skill in our collaborative environment

**Drive technical readiness and continuous improvement**

* Manage technical risks: integrations, APIs, data migrations, and environment readiness
* Promote Agile, DevOps, and continuous delivery practices that improve speed, quality, and predictability
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, reduce bottlenecks, and elevate delivery excellence across teams

**Enable smarter delivery through data and AI**

* Provide data-driven reporting to leadership—progress, risks, trade-offs, and decisions required
* Champion the practical adoption of AI-enabled tools for planning, risk identification, and delivery insights
* Turn delivery data into actionable intelligence that improves team effectiveness

**What you bring**
------------------

**Essential experience:**

* 5+ years managing technical projects, product programs, or platform delivery initiatives
* Proven track record delivering SaaS, product, or technology-enabled solutions
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps practices, release planning, and technical dependencies
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority
* Strong communication, governance, and risk management skills
* Comfort operating in complex, fast-paced environments with multiple priorities and competing stakeholder interests

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in pension, benefits, health, financial services, or regulated delivery environments
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar delivery management tools
* Bilingual English/French capability

Why TELUS Health? You'll work alongside product leaders, engineers, and client-success teams who are genuinely excited about transforming how benefits and pension solutions are delivered. We invest in your growth, encourage innovation, and create space for you to build delivery practices that will scale across the organization.

**Salary Range:** $85,000 - $110,000

Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. We're open to discussing competitive compensation packages tailored to your experience level and expertise.

TELUS Health offers rewarding benefits, which may vary per job function, such as:

* Comprehensive total rewards package highlighting competitive salary and bonus structures, minimum 3 weeks of vacation, and flexible benefits plan to meet the needs of you and your family
* Flexibility to work in-office, virtually or a combination of both
* Generous company matched pension
* Opportunity to give back to communities in which we work, live and serve
* Career growth and learning & development opportunities to develop your skills

**Job Type:** This is for a current vacancy.

**What makes this different:**
------------------------------

* Impact: Your work directly improves how millions of Canadians manage their retirement and benefits
* Growth: You'll shape delivery practices and processes that become the standard across TELUS Health
* Collaboration: You'll work with talented, mission-driven teams across product, technology, and client delivery
* Data-driven: We believe in transparency, reporting, and making decisions backed by evidence

**A bit about us**

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.

Disclaimer: In accordance with the TELUS Health Solutions Data Center Security Policy, as a condition of employment, all team members whose job functions require they work at a Data Center and/or have access to detailed knowledge of technology related to client service delivery, are subject to a Personnel Security Screening conducted through the Government of Canada.

Note for Quebec candidates: if knowledge of English is required for this position, it is because the team member will be asked, on a regular basis, to interact in English with external or internal parties or to use English applications or software as part of their tasks.

By applying to this role, you understand and agree that your information will be shared with the TELUS Group of Companies’ Talent Acquisition team(s) and/or any leader(s) who will be part of the selection process.

Title: Senior Project Manager - Media Technology
Description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

  

**Senior Project Manager – Media Technology**

  

**Who we're looking for:**

  

We are looking for a strong leader to join the Broadcast Engineering team within Rogers as a Sr. Project Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering project management excellence on key strategic initiatives through disciplined execution. The breadth and complexity of these projects cannot be understated. The successful candidate should be able to oversee the impacts, interdependencies and timelines between functional teams and work to ensure project initiatives meet the goals and objectives set forth by the senior and executive leadership teams.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Manage infrastructure-related deployments, upgrades, and strategic technology initiatives from planning through execution.
* Manage project funding, including Capital Authorization (CA) requests, budget development, forecasting, financial tracking, and variance reporting.
* Developed business cases, procurement documentation, and financial approvals required to support project delivery.
* Participate in vendor evaluation and selection processes, including RFP development, proposal reviews, and recommendation activities.
* Manage vendor relationships and holding vendors accountable for contractual obligations, milestones, deliverables, schedules, and project outcomes.
* Coordinate and facilitating workshops, discovery sessions, design reviews, and planning meetings with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with stakeholders to evaluate requirements, scope changes, project impacts, and resource needs.
* Developed and maintaining project plans, schedules, RAID logs, action registers, and project documentation.
* Provide regular project status updates, executive summaries, dashboards, and governance reporting to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify risks, dependencies, issues, and constraints early, and proactively driving mitigation and resolution plans.
* Lead steering committee, governance, and stakeholder discussions to support informed decision-making and project alignment.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure deliverables are completed on time, dependencies are managed, and project momentum is maintained.
* Conduct analysis and providing recommendations to support operational, financial, and technology decisions.
* Ensure alignment between project delivery, financial objectives, strategic priorities, and operational goals.
* Drive accountability across project teams by tracking commitments, following up on actions, removing roadblocks, and ensuring successful execution of key initiatives.
  

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Broadcast Technology, or a related field or experience would be an asset.
* PMP certification preferred; Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and SAFe certification considered assets.
* 7+ years of project management experience, preferably leading complex technology, infrastructure, media asset management, broadcast engineering, or digital media transformation projects.
* Experience delivering projects within a broadcast, media, content production, streaming, or digital media environment.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and technology deployment lifecycles.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, programs, and cross-functional workstreams.
* Experience with Media Asset Management (MAM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), content workflows, video content management systems, or related broadcast technologies.
* Proven experience managing project budgets, capital funding, forecasting, financial reporting, and cost controls.
* Experience developing business cases, Capital Authorization (CA) submissions, procurement documentation, and vendor statements of work.
* Demonstrated experience participating in vendor selection processes, RFP evaluations, contract negotiations, and vendor governance activities.
* Proven ability to manage vendor performance, track deliverables, facilitate workshops, and ensure contractual commitments are achieved.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience presenting project status, risks, financials, and recommendations to senior leadership and steering committees.
* Advanced experience using Microsoft Project, Microsoft 365 applications, and project reporting tools.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and other Atlassian tools considered an asset.
* Strong financial, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and drive projects to successful completion.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing changing priorities and competing business objectives.
* A commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Belonging, and Accessibility, helping create an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and supported.

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including:

Title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support - MENAT
Description:
**Description**
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS)? At AWS Enterprise Support we're looking for a Sr. Technical Account Manager (TAM) to influence the largest enterprises in the world to gain the best value and service from AWS. In the role you will support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across technology areas such as Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, AI/ML, Networking, Serverless, and more. You will have the opportunity to be the technical leader to large enterprises while being their advocate and 'voice of the customer' to AWS product teams.
  
  
As a Senior TAM you will craft and execute technical cloud strategies to drive customers adoption and use of AWS services. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS at our customer, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding operational excellence cloud maturity support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep the customers AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You'll build solutions provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer \* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity \* Develop trusting relationships with customers understanding their business needs and technical challenges \* Using your technical acumen and customer obsession you'll drive technical discussions regarding incidents trade-offs and risk management \* Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C-suite executives \* Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects Business Developers Professional Services Consultants and Sales Account Managers \* With a bias for action you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS \* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions monthly and quarterly metrics detailed pre-launch planning \* Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud

**About The Team**
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in technical roles involving distributed systems, cloud architecture, software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, Data & Analytics, or AI / ML.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as technical account manager, solutions architect, consultant, or support engineer
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for a combination of the following: compute, storage, networking, databases, AI/ML, containers, DevOps, big data and analytics, security
* Demonstrated ability to drive technical discussions and communicate effectively with both engineering teams and executive stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
* Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent Professional experience with AWS services or equivalent cloud platforms (Azure, GCP)
* Experience with AI/ML workloads including foundation models, inference infrastructure, agentic systems, accelerated compute (GPU, custom silicon), or MLOps
* Experience with container orchestration (EKS, ECS, Kubernetes), serverless architectures, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)

Title: VP, Delivery and Customer Success
Description:

Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. As Vice President, Customer Success, you'll take the lead on client health across Appficiency's global delivery portfolio. This is a customer-first leadership role: you'll be the face of delivery excellence for our most strategic accounts, spending your time where it counts most - with clients and the teams who serve them. * Own client health across your portfolio, building the kind of trust and consistency that keeps retention high and relationships strong for the long term
* Champion end-to-end delivery excellence, ensuring every engagement is meticulously planned, resourced, and executed within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standards
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic accounts, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor rather than just a delivery contact
* Match your team's skill set to the demands of each engagement, building and maintaining a resource pool capable of scaling with the business

* Provide the kind of direction and constructive feedback that helps your team consistently hit customer success KPIs, not just individual project milestones
* Turn strong delivery into business growth, actively supporting the conversion of implementation engagements into follow-on opportunities
* Build a client base that is referenceable, ensuring your accounts become some of Appficiency's strongest references
* Manage your portfolio's profitability with the same rigor you apply to client satisfaction, balancing commercial outcomes with delivery excellence

* A career built in delivery or project-implementation leadership and customer success ownership - you've sat close enough to execution to know what it actually takes to keep a client happy
* Direct experience owning the full client lifecycle post-go-live - hypercare transition, steady-state support, QBRs, renewal conversations, and escalation management
* Comfort operating with customer health metrics (NPS, CSAT, retention/churn) as core performance indicators, alongside traditional delivery metrics like scope, time, and budget

* 8-10 years working across ERP and CRM platforms such as NetSuite and Salesforce; familiarity with AI-driven or productivity solutions (e.g., the Microsoft ecosystem) is a strong plus
* Experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations, onsite and remote, on concurrent projects spanning one or more industries

* A track record of leading client-facing delivery organizations where retention and satisfaction are the primary measures of success, not just project throughput

* Strong executive presence - the kind that lets you walk into a C-suite conversation and leave with the client's confidence intact or restored
* A demonstrated history of building, mentoring, and scaling delivery teams that consistently exceed client expectations

Knowledge and understanding of building and service contracts, contracting practices and processes; familiarity with formulating budgets and estimates, reviewing cost reports, preparing financial projections and analyses; advanced knowledge of Microsoft office software systems; mechanical aptitude necessary, familiarity with University of Toronto facility systems required (e.g. laundry, mechanical and engineering systems, telecommunications, security devices and systems). Strong service orientation, leadership and team management, demonstrated ability to organize and direct activities; excellent negotiation and diplomacy skills; proven ability to collaborate and participate effectively within a team; enthusiasm and skill in mentoring staff, particularly student staff; excellent interpersonal and communication skills; demonstrated planning scheduling and supervision skills.

Title: Platform Lead
Description:
**Company Description**

We are a premier media brand with a proven history of delivering impactful content and trusted journalism. Our commitment to excellence and creativity sets us apart in the industry as we continue to grow and evolve to meet current market needs.

**Our Commitment To Diversity:** We strive to be a leader in building and cultivating an employee community framed around fairness, support and opportunity. We believe that what makes us different, makes a difference. And as a team, the diversity of our backgrounds, interests and experiences is what enriches our work, and our workplaces. We welcome all, and we strive for an inclusive culture that allows individual growth and shared success.

 **Job Description**

The **Platform Lead** is a senior technology leader responsible for the architecture, evolution, reliability, and operational performance of Torstar’s shared digital platform capabilities. This role partners closely with the Mobile lead to translate the organization’s technology strategy into scalable, secure, and well-governed platform services that enable mobile and web product teams to deliver effectively.

The Platform Lead provides deep expertise across backend systems, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, integrations, data and analytics infrastructure, content-management capabilities, identity, subscriptions, payments, email platforms, and operational engineering practices. The role leads the platform engineering team and acts as a trusted technical partner to the Mobile lead, with responsibility for platform execution and domain-level technical decisions.

While this role has significant technical and people leadership responsibility, the Chief Product Officer retains overall accountability for organization-wide technology strategy, senior leadership engagement, and the full digital technology portfolio.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and ongoing evolution of Torstar’s shared digital platform services and infrastructure.
* Own the reliability, scalability, security, maintainability, and performance of platform capabilities that support mobile, web, data, editorial, subscription, advertising, and other digital products.
* Lead and develop platform engineering, DevOps, QA, and related technical team members as assigned.
* Partner with the Chief Product Officer on enterprise technology strategy, architecture, investment priorities, and delivery planning.
* Establish and maintain platform engineering standards for APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, security, resilience, and incident management.
* Ensure that platform roadmaps enable product teams—particularly the mobile team—to deliver customer value quickly, reliably, and safely.
* Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions, architectural guidance, and implementation plans.
* Lead the technical assessment, selection, integration, and management of platform technologies, vendors, and external delivery partners.
* Improve engineering productivity through strong developer tooling, automation, documentation, deployment practices, and operational processes.
* Monitor platform health and production-quality metrics; identify risks, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
* Support technology governance by documenting architectural decisions, managing technical debt, and maintaining a clear view of platform dependencies and risks.
* Collaborate with Product, Data, Editorial, Revenue, Security, and other stakeholders to ensure technology solutions meet organizational needs.
* Keep current with developments in cloud platforms, AI, data infrastructure, backend systems, security, and software delivery practices.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering at this level of technical scope and complexity.
* 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading technical teams or major platform initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and shared technology services.
* Strong knowledge of modern cloud computing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, security, system reliability, and software architecture.
* Experience supporting large-scale, consumer-facing digital products or high-availability digital platforms.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor engineers while driving complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Experience with platform domains such as content management, identity and access management, subscriptions, payments, data and analytics, email platforms, or enterprise integrations is strongly preferred.
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* A practical, collaborative approach to balancing platform health, technical debt, delivery needs, and long-term scalability.

  
**Additional Information**

**Success in this role**

Success will mean providing a stable and extensible platform foundation that enables product teams to move quickly, reduces operational risk, improves engineering efficiency, and gives the Chief Product Officer a strong technical partner for organization-wide planning and execution.

Title: Director of Field Operations
Description:

**About the Company:**

Our client is a fibre internet provider

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director of Order Fulfilment and Field Operations, owns the entire post-sale customer journey, from the moment a sale closes through installation, activation, and ongoing service and support. This role leads customer-facing operational functions, including subcontractor and contract management. The incumbent is accountable for building high-performing teams, driving operational excellence across service and installation delivery, and ensuring every customer touchpoint reflects the Company's standard for an exceptional experience as the Company continues its rapid growth. In this highly dynamic position, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in your career and within the organization.

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

* Develop and execute the overall Order Fulfilment strategy spanning all post-sale functions, ensuring alignment with the Company's business objectives, growth plan, and customer experience goals.
* Own end-to-end installation execution and repair for residential, business, and MDU customers, ensuring projects meet quality, timeline, and budget expectations through appropriate control measures.
* Set subcontractor strategy and oversee the full lifecycle: evaluation, onboarding, pricing and contract negotiation, performance tracking, compliance management, and corrective action.
* Establish, monitor, and report on departmental KPIs, service levels, installation metrics, operational performance, customer satisfaction, and employee engagement.
* Build, coach, mentor, and develop leaders and high-performing teams while fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
* Develop and manage departmental budgets, resource planning, workforce forecasting, and operational capacity across service and field delivery.
* Lead the resolution of complex customer escalations and identify root causes to implement long-term corrective actions.
* Establish quality assurance and risk management frameworks across installations and service delivery, identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies to prevent delays and cost overruns.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve workflows, and leverage technology and automation to enhance operational efficiency.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Service, Network, Marketing, Product and Finance, to ensure a seamless end-to-end customer experience.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, safety standards, company policies, privacy standards, and internal controls across all field and service operations.
* Analyze customer feedback, operational data, and industry trends to identify opportunities for service improvements and innovation.
* Develop and maintain operational policies, procedures, service standards, and training programs that support consistency, compliance, and quality.

**What You Bring:**

* You get things done. You anticipate problems and avoid them and fix procedures so they don’t happen again. You don’t make excuses.
* You are customer oriented.
* Proven leadership across both order fulfilment and field operations, with the range to move between strategy and operational detail.
* Strong commercial acumen in contract negotiation, vendor management, and cost structure optimization.
* A data-driven operating style: you manage through metrics, hold teams accountable to service levels, and use customer feedback to drive decisions.

**Experience:**

* Leadership experience in order fulfilment or field operations.
* Experience in telecommunications, including customer operations and field or installation delivery is definitely valuable.
* Demonstrated success managing subcontractors and outsourced delivery models, including performance and compliance management is relevant.
* Experience owning departmental budgets, workforce planning, and operational capacity in a scaling business.
* Knowledge of telecommunications industry standards, safety requirements, and regulatory obligations is beneficial.

**Education:**

* Post secondary degree or diploma is required.
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, operations management, telecommunications is an asset.

* Define and implement structured vendor processes qualification, validation, KPI/scorecards, and captured and drive lesson learn to asses vendor performance and capabilities.
* Act as the primary program liaison with AMD cross-functional teams to vendors, ensuring alignment on technical, business, schedule, and process requirements.
* Collaborate with current and future technology facing architecture and design teams.
* Collaborate with procurement, quality, and reliability teams to bridge AMD requirements with vendor capabilities for production execution.
* Collaborate with architecture and design team to identify, and assess optics technologies and work with vendors and internal teams to evaluate the technologies for alignment to the AMD product roadmap
* Communicate clear product technical status, risk and mitigation strategies to internal and external stakeholders.
* Enable a robust component ecosystem, industry supply chain and NPI acceleration to identify early component risks.
* Lead and participate vendor audit (onsite/virtual) for design and development process alignment and NPI to MP ramp readiness.
* Work in a dynamic and fast-paced product development environment
* Drive process improvements while executing fast time-to-market on products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to lead and sustain cross-functional and cross-organizational teams in a matrixed environment.
* Extensive experience managing complex technical programs; familiarity with server platforms, external third party vendor/supplier management, and Optics Technology concepts is a plus.

Title: D365 Project Manager
Description:
**About Lumovy Technology Solutions, LLC**
At Lumovy Technology Solutions, we are a Microsoft Solutions Partner delivering Dynamics 365, Azure and Power Platform solutions to enterprise clients across the Middle East, North America and South Asia. With delivery teams in the UAE, the USA, Canada, India and Pakistan, we help organizations modernize their finance, supply chain and retail operations on the Microsoft cloud. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementations onsite with our enterprise clients in the UAE. You will own delivery end to end, from mobilization and fit-gap through go-live and hypercare, leading a blended onsite and offshore team and acting as the primary point of accountability for the client.
  
  
This is a client-facing role for a delivery leader who combines ERP lifecycle experience with commercial discipline: someone who protects scope, manages change formally, and keeps senior stakeholders aligned through to a successful go-live.
  
  
**Role Details**

* Location: United Arab Emirates, based onsite at client premises
* Travel: Within the UAE and wider GCC, as required by the engagement
* Employment type: Full-time, permanent

**Essential Functions**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and/or Commerce implementations, from mobilization and requirements through go-live and hypercare, within agreed scope, timeline, budget and quality.
* Build and maintain the integrated project plan covering workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource allocation and key decision points, aligned to Microsoft Success by Design.
* Govern the core ERP lifecycle: fit-gap analysis, solution design sign-off, conference room pilots, SIT and UAT, data migration, cutover planning, go-live readiness and transition to support.
* Act as the primary onsite point of contact for client stakeholders, from executive sponsors to process owners, ensuring transparent communication, expectation management and timely decisions.
* Run project governance through weekly status reporting, steering committee packs, RAID and decision logs, and formal milestone acceptance.
* Own project financials, including budget tracking, forecast versus actuals, milestone billing, resource utilization and margin protection.
* Enforce SOW scope through formal change control: assess impact, raise change requests, secure client approval and re-baseline plans accordingly.
* Identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies, including third-party vendors and integration partners such as POS, payment and banking providers, escalating early with clear mitigation options.
* Lead a blended onsite and offshore team, managing handoffs, time-zone coordination and the quality of offshore deliverables.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate, using Azure DevOps for backlog, sprint and test management.
* Coordinate with Microsoft, including FastTrack where applicable, on solution reviews, go-live readiness assessments and support escalations.
* Support account growth by contributing to estimates, delivery approaches and change proposals, and by identifying extension opportunities with the client.
* Mentor team members and build a culture of ownership, accountability and delivery quality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.
* 7+ years of project management experience in IT or technology consulting, including at least 4 years managing ERP implementations.
* A minimum of two full-lifecycle Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (or Dynamics AX) implementations as Project Manager, including at least one go-live.
* Hands-on experience managing data migration, cutover and hypercare for enterprise ERP programmes.
* Working knowledge of the core D365 F&O modules (Finance, Supply Chain Management) and how they integrate with surrounding systems.
* Proven ownership of project budgets, change requests and milestone billing in a client services or Microsoft partner environment.
* Experience leading blended onsite and offshore delivery teams.
* Proficiency in Azure DevOps and Microsoft Project or equivalent planning tools.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with experience presenting to steering committees and C-level sponsors.
* Based in the UAE or able to relocate at short notice.

**Nice To Have**

* Delivery experience with enterprise clients in the UAE or wider GCC (strongly preferred).
* PMP, PRINCE2 or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications, such as MB-300 or MB-700.
* Experience with Dynamics 365 Commerce, POS platforms (e.g. LS Central, NCR) or payment integrations.
* Exposure to Azure integration services, Power Platform and Dual-write.
* Industry experience in retail, distribution or manufacturing.
* Arabic language skills.
* Valid UAE driving licence.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive, market-aligned compensation package.
* UAE employment visa and medical insurance.
* The opportunity to lead high-profile Dynamics 365 programmes for leading enterprises in the region.
* Career growth within a fast-growing Microsoft partner, with access to Microsoft certification and learning programmes.

* *Simplify Complexity: We take complex ideas and tasks and distill into simpler, more manageable forms, reducing clutter and noise along the way*

* *Develop Stories: We transform information and insights into the right story for the right audience*

***How we do it:***

* Support leadership with integrated program and change management for 2 scoped and funded transformation initiatives: (i) the modernization of the customer analytics datamart; and, (ii) the modernization of the team’s analytical toolset

* Create and maintain program charters, roadmaps, integrated delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, resource assumptions, risks, issues, decisions and outcome measures.

* Establish practical governance and operating rhythms, including steering forums, working teams, status reporting, decision logs, risk escalation and executive updates.

* Coordinate across business and technology partners with a deep appreciation of requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.

* Develop and execute change management strategies covering stakeholder analysis, impact assessment, readiness, communications, engagement, training, adoption and sustainment.

* Help leadership with the transition from current-state to future-state capabilities, including sequencing, migration, testing, cutover, stabilization and decommissioning.

* Identify and manage impacts to analytical processes, controls, roles, skills and operating practices arising from the modernization agenda.

* Translate complex program, data and technology topics into concise, audience-appropriate narratives, recommendations and decisions for senior leaders and delivery teams.

* Promote continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned, strengthening delivery practices and identifying opportunities to simplify or accelerate future work.

**Key Competencies:**

**Program Management:** Structure and drive complex, multi-workstream initiatives from definition through implementation. Establish clear scope, outcomes, plans, governance, controls and accountabilities; manage milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, issues and decisions; and maintain momentum through ambiguity and competing priorities.

**Driving Change:** Plan and drive change through words and actions. Assess stakeholder and organizational impacts, build sponsorship and readiness, develop practical adoption plans and take personal responsibility for ensuring changes are implemented and sustained.

**Business-Technology Coordination:** Bridge business, analytical and technology perspectives. Translate needs and use cases into actionable requirements, facilitate trade-off decisions and maintain alignment across delivery teams throughout design, build, testing, implementation and stabilization.

**Planning and Organizing:** Define objectives, sequence work, estimate time frames, anticipate needs and priorities, and monitor progress across multiple interdependent activities and deadlines.

**Influencing and Persuading:** Build commitment to a course of action without relying on formal authority. Understand the audience, adapt the approach and persist constructively through resistance or competing viewpoints.

**Relationship Management:** Develop and maintain trusted relationships across organizational boundaries. Stay connected to key stakeholders, understand downstream impacts and work collaboratively to accomplish shared goals.

**Communication and Storytelling:** Communicate clearly in writing, presentations and discussion. Distill complex technical and business information into straightforward narratives, choices and recommendations that audiences can understand and act upon.

**Problem Solving and Decision Support:** Evaluate information, alternatives, constraints and consequences systematically. Surface the decisions required, frame practical options and recommend a path forward.

**Driving Results:** Establish ambitious but realistic objectives, assume accountability for outcomes and persist through obstacles to deliver measurable progress and value.

**Business Acumen:** Apply knowledge of banking, analytics and financial concepts to connect modernization choices with customer, employee, risk, operational and P&L outcomes.

**Knowledge & Skills:**

* University degree or college diploma; relevant graduate education is an asset.

* Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in program management, project management, change management, business transformation, technology delivery, strategy, consulting or related fields.

* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Prosci, CCMP, Agile or comparable delivery/change credentials are assets.

* Advanced knowledge of program and project management practices, including scope, planning, governance, dependency management, risk and issue management, financial tracking, delivery reporting and benefits realization.

* Advanced knowledge of organizational change management, including stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, readiness, communications, learning, adoption and sustainment.

* Advanced understanding of how business, data, analytics and technology teams collaborate in large, matrixed organizations.

* Advanced structured thinking, problem-solving and decision-support skills.

* Strong PowerPoint and written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to simplify complex data and technology content into concise, business-friendly narratives.

* Ability to earn the trust and respect of business partners, analytical practitioners, technology teams and leaders at working, senior and executive levels.

* Ability to influence effectively without formal authority and navigate ambiguity, competing priorities and changing circumstances.

* Ability to identify and manage delivery, operational, stakeholder and adoption risks and escalate issues with sound judgment.

* Ability to facilitate planning sessions, design discussions, steering committees, decision forums, retrospectives and working sessions.

* Ability to establish clear governance and management information without creating unnecessary administrative burden.

* Working knowledge of cloud data platform and analytical tool modernization concepts, including data migration, environment transition, testing, cutover, user enablement and legacy decommissioning.

* General business and financial acumen

Title: Director of Information Security (Saudi Only)
Description:
**About Lucidya**
Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Management platform that helps organizations understand, engage, and serve their customers at scale. Our platform brings together customer intelligence, omnichannel engagement, and agentic AI so teams can turn customer insight into meaningful action.
  
  
As we grow across enterprise and government markets in the region, protecting customer data and earning trust are central to how we build products and run our business.
  
  
**The Role**
We are hiring a
**Director of Information Security**
to lead and scale Lucidya's security function across our products, cloud infrastructure, corporate environment, and compliance programs.
  
  
Reporting directly to the
**Chief Technology Officer**
, you will own the security roadmap, build and lead the security team, and partner with Engineering, Product, SRE, DevOps, IT, Legal, People, Sales, and Customer Experience.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. One day you might be reviewing an architecture design or leading an incident response; the next, walking an auditor through our controls or explaining our security posture to a government customer. Your job is to turn security requirements into practical controls, clear ownership, and measurable progress.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
*Security Leadership and Governance*

* Define and execute Lucidya's security strategy and roadmap, aligned with business priorities and customer commitments
* Lead, mentor, and grow the security team with clear responsibilities and development plans
* Drive agentic transformation across the team's operations, applying AI agents to work such as alert triage, evidence collection, vulnerability management, and security questionnaires
* Own security policies, standards, risk assessments, and the risk register, including processes for exceptions, risk acceptance, and escalation
* Manage security tooling, service providers, and budget, and report posture, risks, and incidents to executive leadership

*Compliance and Audit Readiness*

* Lead the implementation and maintenance of controls for Saudi PDPL, NCA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other relevant frameworks
* Maintain the Information Security Management System and coordinate control ownership across departments
* Keep audit evidence accurate and ready, manage audit preparation and findings, and verify that documented controls actually operate effectively
* Partner with Legal on data protection, retention, access, and contractual security requirements

*Product, Application, and Cloud Security*

* Embed security into architecture, development, testing, and deployment, including automated scanning of code, dependencies, secrets, containers, and infrastructure
* Define release security criteria, remediation timelines, and exception processes
* Lead threat modeling and security reviews for major product changes, integrations, and AI capabilities
* Oversee penetration testing, adversarial testing, and vulnerability assessments through to verified resolution
* Review security across AWS and GCP (identity, privileged access, networking, encryption, secrets, logging) and maintain visibility over internet-facing assets

*Corporate Security and Awareness*

* Set security requirements for employee devices, identities, and internal applications, and work with IT to implement and verify them
* Oversee access reviews across onboarding, role changes, and offboarding
* Run security awareness training, phishing exercises, and targeted education for technical and business teams
* Assess the security risk of third-party tools and vendors handling company or customer data
* Define and verify network and physical security standards for our office site

*Security Operations and Incident Response*

* Own the security operations model, including internal responsibilities, external SOC/MDR providers, monitoring coverage, and after-hours escalation
* Oversee log collection, detection, alert triage, and investigation across cloud, application, identity, endpoint, and network
* Maintain incident response plans and playbooks, lead incident coordination and post-incident reviews, and run regular simulations
* Work with Legal, leadership, and customer teams on timely, accurate notifications when incidents affect customers

*Customer Trust and Vulnerability Disclosure*

* Manage Lucidya's vulnerability disclosure program from researcher contact through closure
* Support Sales and Customer Experience with security questionnaires, assessments, and technical discussions, backed by approved, reusable assurance materials
* Review proposed customer security commitments to make sure they're accurate and achievable
* Serve as the primary security contact for auditors, testing providers, and customer security teams

**Requirements**
**Experience**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading security teams or programs
* Experience securing a SaaS platform or comparable cloud-based software environment
* A track record spanning both technical security and governance, risk, and compliance
* Hands-on experience implementing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, including direct involvement in external audits
* Practical familiarity with Saudi PDPL and NCA requirements, and the ability to translate them into technical controls and evidence
* Experience leading investigations, incident response, and vulnerability remediation across multiple teams
* Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of application and API security, secure development practices, and common vulnerability classes
* Practical experience with CI/CD security controls: code, dependency, container, secret, and infrastructure scanning
* Strong AWS, Azure or GCP security knowledge, with the ability to oversee controls across both
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, infrastructure as code, and modern deployment architectures
* Experience with SIEM, cloud security monitoring, endpoint protection, identity management, and vulnerability management tools
* Ability to automate security and evidence-collection work, with hands-on experience applying AI agents or LLM-based tooling to security operations

**Leadership and Communication**

* Proven ability to build accountable teams and drive improvement across departments
* Sound judgment when balancing security risk, delivery needs, and customer commitments
* Clear communication with engineers, executives, auditors, and customers alike
* Strong ownership, including following through until corrective actions are verified complete

**Benefits**
**Why Join Lucidya**

* Real ownership: shape the security function of a fast-growing AI SaaS company from the ground up
* Direct access: work closely with the CTO and partner with leaders across the business
* Meaningful impact: protect products and infrastructure trusted by enterprise and government customers
* Interesting problems: tackle security challenges spanning multi-cloud environments, customer data, and agentic AI
* Room to build: grow a team and lead its agentic transformation, using AI to strengthen both security and engineering execution
* Our culture: we value commitment, passion, innovation, and compassion

If you are motivated by building strong teams, solving hard security problems, and turning customer trust into everyday practice, we would love to hear from you.

Our ideal candidate will have
  
  

* 7+ years experience working in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services or other similarly customer-centric role for a technical product (ideally consumption based)

Title: Regional Manager, Fleet Strategy, Planning and Programs, MEATR, MEATR DSP
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver orders. Our goal is to exceed the expectations of all our customers. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile delivery space.  
  
The MEATR (Middle East, Africa, and Turkey) Fleet organization is responsible for managing and growing Amazon's Last Mile Fleet across the region. We are seeking an exceptional Senior Manager to lead Fleet Strategy, Planning and Programs for the MEATR (Africa, Middle East, and Turkey) region—one of our fastest-growing and most dynamic markets.  
  
In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic architect of MEATRs fleet operations, responsible for the complete fleet lifecycle from demand forecasting and procurement to operational excellence and partner experience. You'll leverage sophisticated analytical modeling to predict fleet requirements years in advance, drive operational excellence through data-driven insights, and ensure our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) have the tools and support they need to succeed.  
This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of Amazon's logistics capabilities in a high-growth region. You'll work at the intersection of strategy, operations, analytics, and partnership management—driving decisions that impact hundreds of millions of dollars in capital investments while building the foundation for sustainable growth.  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep analytical capabilities with strong business acumen and exceptional stakeholder management skills. You'll need to be equally comfortable building sophisticated forecasting models, coaching operations teams on best practices, and presenting strategic recommendations to senior leadership. You'll thrive in ambiguity, design scalable solutions for emerging markets, and have a commitment to operational excellence and customer obsession.  
This role requires approximately 30% travel across the MEATR region to build relationships, conduct operational assessments, and drive change management initiatives.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Fleet Demand Planning & Forecasting  
  
Design and develop scalable fleet demand modeling to predict last mile van / size requirements across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey  
Create demand plans for multiple vehicle specifications (diesel/electric, long/short wheel base, specialized configurations) across long-term strategic (+3 years), medium-term tactical (12-18 months), and short-term operational (Consolidate input from diverse stakeholders to ensure fleet plans always consume the latest available assumptions and business strategies  
  
2. Strategic Partnerships & Vendor Management  
Develop and execute strategic partnerships across the MEATR transportation ecosystem, focusing on long-term value creation with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), rental/leasing providers, upfitting vendors, maintenance service providers, and parts suppliers (in partnership with Global Fleet Procurement GFP organization)  
Identify and capitalize on commercial opportunities through market analysis, competitive benchmarking, cost optimization initiatives, multi-country fleet sharing, and alternative supply channels (e.g., used vehicle markets)  
  
3. Network Capacity & Supply Chain Optimization  
Lead strategic initiatives to optimize network capacity across MEATR, balancing fleet supply and demand across stations, coordinating short-term deployment scheduling, and optimizing for seasonal demand variations  
Collaborate extensively with Finance business partners to ensure plans are efficient and meet peak demand requirements, drive efficient capital allocation (CAPEX), optimize operating expenses (OPEX), and develop Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models  
Develop innovative program management mechanisms to drive data-driven decision-making across make vs. buy vs. rent trade-offs, vehicle type mix optimization, asset utilization improvements, and investment prioritization  
Monitor and optimize key metrics to ensure smooth supply chain operations, addressing procurement lead times, parts availability, and cross-border logistics complexities unique to MEATR markets  
  
4. DSP Partner Experience & Voice of Customer  
Establish and expand listening mechanisms to capture Delivery Service Partner feedback including regular surveys, sentiment analysis, focus groups, partner councils, operational data analysis, and direct engagement during station visits  
Analyze, report, and take action on customer feedback data to identify and drive opportunities to improve the level of service GFP offers to DSP partners, combining qualitative sentiment data with quantitative service benchmarking  
Identify and prioritize DSP pain points related to fleet operations including vehicle reliability, maintenance processes, administrative burden, cost transparency, and training gaps  
Develop and launch innovative programs and value-added services to improve DSP experience and productivity (e.g., preventive maintenance programs, roadside assistance, simplified processes, self-service tools, training materials)  
Measure DSP satisfaction through Net Promoter Score (NPS), program adoption rates, and qualitative feedback themes, with target improvements of +5 NPS points annually  
Collaborate with DSP Program teams across organizations to ensure fleet decisions consider partner impact, co-develop solutions to shared challenges, and maintain strong exchange of insights on partner needs  
  
5. Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence  
Own executive-level business reviews and strategic planning sessions, delivering data-driven insights and actionable recommendations to VP and senior leadership stakeholders  
Write and contribute to compelling business cases using information synthesized from multiple stakeholders, propose and obtain approval from functional leaders, and maintain project schedules that enable teams to succeed  
Take accountability while providing transparent status updates, proactively asking for help and immediately escalating issues and problems as necessary to remove blockers  
  
6. Innovation & Strategic Initiatives  
Drive the transition to electrification by integrating Electric Vehicle (EV) planning into business-as-usual fleet requirement processes, considering charging infrastructure, range requirements, and total cost of ownership  
Extend Fleet Requirement Planning processes to new business customer organizations (e.g., Sub-same Day, DSP Lite) and new countries as MEATR expands, building replicable playbooks for rapid market entry  
Lead full life-cycle of complex cross-functional projects and programs with considerable impact across multiple organizations, working to understand business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, and reasons behind leadership decisions  
Design solutions that can adapt to each MEATR market's unique maturity level, account for varying data availability and quality, work within local constraints, and maintain global standards while allowing regional flexibility  
  
A day in the life  
Your day will be dynamic, strategic, and highly impactful. You might start by reviewing overnight fleet utilization data across MEATR markets, identifying a pattern of underutilization in one country and overdemand in another—prompting you to coordinate a cross-border vehicle transfer. You'll join a strategic planning session with Finance to present your updated 18-month fleet forecast, defending your assumptions and securing approval for a significant vehicle procurement order.  
Mid-morning, you'll dive into your forecasting model, adjusting parameters based on new network expansion plans shared by the Operations team, then run scenario analyses to understand the impact on CAPEX requirements.  
After lunch, you might review DSP feedback survey results, identifying a recurring theme about maintenance delays. You'll brainstorm solutions with the maintenance vendor and draft a proposal for a new preventive maintenance program. You'll then prepare for your afternoon executive business review, creating visualizations that tell a compelling story about fleet performance trends and your strategic recommendations.  
Late afternoon brings a call with regional fleet managers across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey—you're coaching them on a new audit framework and gathering their input on local market dynamics that should inform your demand forecast. You wrap up your day by analyzing repair cost trends, identifying an opportunity to consolidate vendors and save on OPEX.  
Throughout, you're the critical link ensuring our fleet remains reliable, safe, cost-efficient, and perfectly sized to meet customer demand—balancing analytical rigor with operational pragmatism and strategic thinking.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* 7+ years of management experience, small business logistics, or supply chain / planning experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Travel up to 50% of the time

**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.**

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**

**Role Vision and Impact**

The Senior Director, Information Security and End-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

The mission of this strategic role is to **protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations.** The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the **Board of Directors (BoD),** the **Audit Committee,** the **CBC/Radio-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET)** and the **T&I Management Executive Team (MET).**

Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations**

* Develop, champion and execute an enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
* Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
* Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
* Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

  

**Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and** **Broadcast/Operational** **Technology (OT) Environments**

* Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
* Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

  

**Governance, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance**

Description:

The role will coordinate technical delivery, regulatory and operational framework development, service bundle definition and commercialization, the client’s technical laboratory establishment, and procurement and market engagement activities within the agreed PMO assignment.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

Nationwide CCTV Deployment Planning and Coordination

* Lead program level planning, mobilization, and delivery coordination for the nationwide CCTV deployment program within the agreed PMO scope.
* Develop and maintain the technical workstream delivery plan, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, costs, and benefits, and provide validated updates to the integrated program baseline maintained by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls.
* Coordinate technical workstreams covering CCTV infrastructure, command-and-control platforms, connectivity, data storage, monitoring, analytics, cybersecurity, and systems integration.
* Define deployment models, implementation phases, site prioritization criteria, rollout sequencing, and readiness requirements.
* Coordinate and monitor the plans, interfaces, approvals, and readiness evidence of the client-appointed delivery entities responsible for site surveys, technical assessments, design, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Ensure alignment between technology deployment, operational processes, service requirements, and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Monitor implementation progress and take corrective action where there are schedule, cost, quality, resource, or technical risks.
* Coordinate delivery activities across internal teams, contractors, technology suppliers, government entities, and other external partners.
* Coordinate confirmation of technical standards, acceptance criteria, quality controls, and documentation requirements with the responsible technical and delivery owners, and monitor the associated assurance and readiness evidence.
* Coordinate program level transition planning and readiness reviews for business-as-usual operations, including support models, maintenance arrangements, service levels, and operational handover.
  

  

Regulatory and Operational Framework Development

* Coordinate the development of regulatory compliance and operational frameworks required to support the CCTV program with the responsible client and specialist owners.
* Define policies, procedures, standards, controls, roles, responsibilities, and approval mechanisms for CCTV deployment and operation.
* Ensure that program activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, privacy requirements, data protection principles, cybersecurity standards, and government policies.
* Develop operating models covering surveillance operations, monitoring, incident management, access controls, data retention, evidence handling, system maintenance, and service support.
* Establish operational readiness criteria, service management processes, escalation routes, and performance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, data protection, law enforcement, and operational stakeholders.
* Support the development of regulatory submissions, technical standards, operating procedures, compliance controls, and assurance documentation.
* Establish mechanisms for ongoing compliance monitoring, audit readiness, risk management, and continuous improvement.
  

  

Technical Laboratory Establishment and Operational Readiness

* Lead program-level planning and coordination for establishing the client’s technical laboratory as an innovation, testing, demonstration, and operational readiness environment.
* Define the Lab’s purpose, scope, capabilities, governance model, operating procedures, and success measures.
* Develop requirements for Lab infrastructure, systems, equipment, connectivity, cybersecurity, data environments, and testing capabilities.
* Coordinate and monitor the program plans, interfaces, and readiness evidence for the design, procurement, installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of Lab facilities and technology by the appointed delivery entities.
* Establish processes for proof-of-concept testing, solution validation, interoperability assessment, demonstrations, training, and technology evaluation.
* Develop the Lab operating model, including staffing, support, maintenance, access management, health and safety, and asset management.
* Coordinate operational readiness reviews, track readiness evidence and outstanding actions, and support formal acceptance of the Lab by the authorized client and operational owners before launch.
* Develop a roadmap for future Lab capabilities, innovation partnerships, vendor engagement, and continuous improvement.

* Ensure that lessons learned and validated technical standards are incorporated into the wider CCTV deployment program

Procurement and Market Engagement

* activities, and market engagement.
* Coordinate the development and specialist review of technical requirements, statements of work, specifications, evaluation criteria, service levels, and acceptance criteria with the responsible technical owners.
* Support market sounding, supplier briefings, requests for information, requests for proposals, tenders, and competitive dialogue activities.
* Engage with technology vendors, system integrators, telecommunications providers, infrastructure partners, consultants, and specialist service providers.
* Assess market capability, technology maturity, supplier capacity, delivery risks, and commercial models.
* Participate in supplier evaluation, clarification sessions, negotiations, due diligence, and recommendation processes.
* Ensure procurement packages are aligned with the program roadmap, regulatory framework, operating model, and commercial objectives.
* Support contract mobilization, supplier governance, performance management, change control, and issue resolution.

* Monitor supplier delivery against contractual requirements, milestones, quality standards, and key performance indicators

Program Governance, Controls, and Reporting

* Apply the program governance, controls, reporting, and escalation framework established by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls, and lead the corresponding technical assurance and operational readiness arrangements.
* Prepare technical delivery inputs to program board papers, steering committee materials, executive reports, dashboards, and delivery updates.
* Monitor program performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, issues, dependencies, benefits, and operational readiness.
* Maintain technical workstream registers, including risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, changes, actions, and lessons learned, and provide updates to the consolidated program records.
* Lead technical and operational readiness reviews and provide the technical evidence and recommendations required for program stage gates, assurance reviews, and health checks.
* Ensure that decisions and actions are documented, assigned, tracked, and escalated where necessary.
* Provide clear recommendations to senior leadership on program priorities, risks, options, and corrective actions.
* Ensure program documentation is complete, accurate, current, and compliant with governance requirements.

* Distinguishes ownership of the PMO governance framework and integrated baseline from Technical Delivery’s technical assurance, readiness reviews, and delivery inputs.

Stakeholder and Cross-Functional Leadership

* Build strong relationships with government stakeholders, regulators, internal business units, suppliers, technology partners, and operational teams.
* Lead cross-functional workshops and facilitate alignment between technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, and procurement stakeholders.
* Manage competing priorities and resolve complex program-level issues.
* Communicate technical and program information clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
* Support stakeholder engagement, change management, communications, training, and adoption activities.
* Represent the program at internal and external forums, industry events, supplier meetings, and governance committees.
  

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, information technology, project management, telecommunications, business, or a related discipline.
* 20 experience managing complex technical programs, preferably involving large-scale technology deployment, security systems, smart infrastructure, telecommunications, or public-sector transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading nationwide, multi-site, or multi-stakeholder implementation programs.
* Experience developing technical and operational frameworks, governance models, standards, and operating procedures.

* Strong understanding of procurement, supplier engagement, tendering, technical evaluation, and contract mobilization.
* Experience working with CCTV, video management systems, command-and-control platforms, IoT, analytics, artificial intelligence, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, or related technologies.
* Proven experience managing program budgets, schedules, risks, dependencies, vendors, and delivery performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Program or project management certification, such as PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or equivalent.
* Degree or professional qualification in engineering, technology, cybersecurity, telecommunications, or systems integration.
* Experience in physical security, surveillance, smart cities, critical infrastructure, public safety, or government technology programs.
