Title: Manager, Operations Integration Subways
Description:
**Job Description**
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.
  
  
At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.
  
  
The Manager, Operations Integration – Subways plays a key role in ensuring the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of subway and LRT services. The position provides operational, technical and functional oversight of operator, maintainer and project agreements across the subway and LRT programs, supporting high-quality, customer-focused transportation services that are safe, timely and delivered in accordance with contractual requirements.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**

* Oversee the planning, coordination and delivery of subway and LRT services, ensuring safe, effective and efficient customer movement, service levels, schedules and operational plans align with Metrolinx strategies and organizational objectives.
* Manage operator, contractor and maintainer performance against service level plans, contractual obligations and KPIs; identify non-compliance, implement mitigation and corrective action strategies, and ensure quality assurance and continuous service improvement.
* Lead the development, implementation and monitoring of operational plans, management programs, policies, procedures, workflows, SOPs and performance measures in consultation with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, regulatory, legal and contractual requirements through audits, monitoring, risk assessments and engagement with regulatory bodies, while incorporating industry best practices and emerging issues.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level reports, presentations and operational studies outlining service performance, KPIs, strategic directions, findings and improvement initiatives to Metrolinx leadership and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate operational activities across Metrolinx departments and business units, providing transportation expertise and input into major service improvement projects, service extensions, operational planning and negotiations with internal partners.
* Represent Metrolinx on contractual, operational and transportation development matters with service providers, contractors, consultants, industry associations, government representatives and other external partners.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, partners, vendors and government representatives through ongoing communication, consultation, negotiation and issue resolution.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by researching, recommending and implementing new or revised standards, specifications, processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, customer service, design standards and safety.
* Manage departmental activities, service delivery objectives and budgetary requirements while providing leadership, guidance and constructive feedback to contractors, consultants and partners, ensuring appropriate resources, capabilities, performance standards and positive working relationships.

**What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?**

* Completion of a degree in Business, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Demonstrated years' of progressively responsible experience in the transportation and/or public transit sector, including leadership of frontline staff and/or project management, ideally within the public sector.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is considered an asset. A Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation is also an asset but not required.
* Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal competencies, including service-focused and transformational leadership, effective communication, sound decision-making, delivering results, building high-performance cultures, energizing teams, personal effectiveness and alignment with organizational values.
* Knowledge of applicable Human Resources legislation, including the Employment Standards Act and Occupational Health and Safety Act, as well as railway operating rules and legislation governing railway, environmental, public and employee safety.
* Strong knowledge of transportation, engineering and planning, including commuter rapid transit (subway, LRT and BRT) system planning, design and delivery, maintenance facilities, stations, storage yards and related infrastructure.
* Understanding of transit system functional requirements and technical components, including signalling and train control, SCADA, communications, trackwork, vehicle and wayside interfaces, traction power, power supply and distribution, mechanical systems, system and train simulation, tunnels, and fire and life safety systems.
* Knowledge of System Safety Certification processes and the ability to identify technical inadequacies, evaluate plans and apply appropriate rail transportation analytical tools.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing employees and contractors, applying collective agreement provisions, overseeing vendors and externally provided services, monitoring contractual performance, and understanding IT capabilities and budget planning and monitoring processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint), with strong written, verbal, interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to prepare reports and communicate operational studies, findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

Title: GCC Technical Lead – Building Services
Description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
  
  
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
The Building Services Technical GCC Lead is responsible for coordinating technical capability, quality improvement, standardization and knowledge development across the GCC Building Services disciplines, including Electrical, Mechanical, Public Health and Fire Protection.

The role acts as the central technical integrator between GCC Heads of Discipline and Middle East technical and project teams. It converts project needs, quality findings and lessons learned into coordinated improvement plans, practical standards, targeted training and measurable capability growth.

This is primarily a technical leadership and enablement role. It strengthens the team’s ability to take greater ownership and responsibility for design delivery while supporting consistent project outcomes across locations, disciplines and project stages.

  

**1. Technical Strategy, Governance & Performance**

* Own and coordinate the Building Services technical improvement roadmap for GCC, aligned with business priorities and Middle East project requirements.
* Translate technical objectives into practical initiatives with clear owners, milestones, success measures and review cycles.
* Maintain a consolidated view of capability gaps, improvement priorities, technical risks and dependencies across disciplines.
* Maintain dashboards and action trackers covering capability growth, standards adoption, issue closure, reviewer readiness and recurring findings.
* Conduct regular effectiveness reviews and adjust priorities based on evidence, project outcomes and business needs.

**2. Training, Upskilling & Technical Community**

* Lead technical learning-needs analysis across Electrical, Mechanical, Public Health and Fire Protection and coordinate structured learning plans.
* Use formal training, project-based learning, mentoring, technical clinics, design reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions to build practical capability.
* Identify internal subject-matter experts and external learning support and develop repeatable training materials and technical guidance.
* Build an active Building Services technical community with channels for technical questions, peer review, knowledge exchange and recognition of good practice.
* Monitor participation, competency development, practical application and post-training effectiveness.

**3. Discipline Leadership, Middle East Alignment & Project Readiness**

* Chair a regular Building Services technical forum with GCC Heads of Discipline and nominated technical leads.
* Coordinate discipline-specific improvement plans while ensuring shared priorities, interfaces and standards are managed consistently.
* Act as the principal technical coordination link between GCC Building Services and Middle East technical, discipline and project leadership.
* Coordinate early technical engagement for project mobilisation, including competencies, standards, reviewers, deliverable expectations and known risks.
* Support reviewer readiness, succession needs and progressive transfer of technical ownership to GCC teams where capability and project risk permit.

**4. Standards, Templates, Stage Deliverables & Innovation**

* Coordinate the development, review, approval and adoption of common technical templates, calculation tools, schedules, checklists and workflows.
* Drive consistency in schematics, drawing content, model information and level of detail for Concept, Schematic, Detailed Design, Tender and IFC stages.
* Maintain clear stage-based expectations for technical deliverables, design maturity, review evidence and interdisciplinary coordination.
* Ensure standards are accessible, version-controlled, communicated, periodically reviewed and embedded in project delivery.
* Identify and pilot improved methods, automation and digital tools, capturing evidence of value before coordinating wider adoption.

**5. Project Technical Issues, Quality & Lessons Learned**

* Act as the Building Services single point of contact for significant or recurring technical issues arising on GCC-supported projects.
* Triage issues with Heads of Discipline, project leads, reviewers and Middle East stakeholders, ensuring clear ownership and timely resolution.
* Facilitate root-cause reviews for recurring findings, rework, coordination failures or capability gaps.
* Convert findings into corrective and preventive actions, including updated guidance, checks, templates, tools, briefings or targeted training.
* Maintain an issues-and-improvements register, share lessons learned and verify that agreed actions are closed and embedded.

**6. Collaboration with Other Technical GCC Leads**

* Establish a regular coordination forum with Technical GCC Leads for Structures, Specialists and other Property & Buildings disciplines to align capability priorities and planned initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-discipline knowledge-sharing activities, including joint training, technical showcases, lessons-learned sessions and “get to know” introductions.
* Arrange informal technical engagement activities, such as technical breaks, networking gatherings and community sessions, to strengthen connections across the GCC P&B technical community.
* Identify common challenges and opportunities were shared guidance, tools, speakers or learning programmes can benefit multiple disciplines.
* Maintain a coordinated calendar of cross-P&B activities, avoiding duplication and promoting broad participation and reuse of good practice.

**7. Collaboration with the GCC P&B Lead and Director of P&B**

* Maintain regular alignment with the GCC P&B Lead and Director of P&B on technical priorities, emerging ideas, capability gaps, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate technical programmes and improvement plans with wider GCC P&B business priorities, communications and team initiatives.

Title: QNB3789 - Senior Manager – Fraud Assurance & Strategy (Qatarization)
Description:
**About QNB**
Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
  
  
QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
  
  
QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
  
  
Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
  
  
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
  
  
**Job Purpose Summary**
The incumbent is responsible for handling and governing the Group’s Non-Card Fraud Operations capability under Group Compliance, ensuring continuous fraud monitoring, timely operational response, and effective escalation in line with Qatar Central Bank (QCB) requirements and the Bank’s Fraud Management Framework.
  
  
The role combines fraud assurance responsibilities with direct accountability for after hours, weekend, and public holiday fraud operations, including decision making for fraud prevention, detection, recovery, and regulatory communication where required.
  
  
**The Incumbent Ensures That**

* Fraud risks are monitored and managed on a continuous basis;
* The Operations Staff’s work schedule and roster is properly prepared, maintained and managed.
* Fraud incidents are responded to in real time, including customer protection actions and interbank coordination;
* The Bank maintains a proper fraud operations function, as required by QCB regulations; and
* Operational execution is supported by robust governance, controls, escalation frameworks and assurance mechanisms.

The role plays a critical part in protecting the Group and clients from financial loss, regulatory exposure, and reputational damage arising from fraud risk.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities By Dimensions**

* Shareholder & Financial:
* Proactively assist the design and handle the implementation of the Group’s Non-Card Fraud Operations model, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations and approved capacity assumptions.
* Ensure that fraud risks across all non-card channels (e.g. Digital Channels, Branch Channels, RTGS, wallets, PSP linked activity) are continuously monitored, with timely operational response.
* Oversee and approve time critical fraud intervention actions during after hours, weekends, and public holidays, including customer contact and verification for high risk and suspicious transactions, account restrictions, and recovery coordination.
* Ensure and assist in effective use, performance monitoring, and continuous optimization of fraud detection rules and scenarios within the Enterprise Fraud Management System (EFMS).
* Periodically assess fraud losses, near misses, and emerging typologies to inform risk based prioritization and strategic enhancements.
* Support the development of cost effective, operational models, balancing regulatory compliance with efficiency and resource constraints.
* Define, implement, and monitor KPIs and SLAs for fraud monitoring and response activities.
* Contribute to the Group Fraud Risk Assessment process by providing operational insights derived from real time fraud monitoring activity.
* Promote cost consciousness while ensuring that fraud response capability remains effective, resilient, and regulator defensible.
* Assess the fraud risk exposure periodically to identify specific potential schemes and events that the business needs to mitigate
* Assist in designing prevention techniques to avoid potential key fraud risk events to mitigate possible impacts on the Group.
* Assist in implementing detection techniques to uncover fraud events when preventive measures fail or unmitigated risks are realized.
* Assist in performing needs analysis to enhance the fraud monitoring system and to widen the scope of the coverage to cover more channels, products and fields.
* Suggests new testing and monitoring techniques covering the fraud risk
* Responsible for the identifying awareness topics priorities to executive management linked to the Fraud Control.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial & non-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal & External):
* Ensure timely and effective customer protection actions, including customer calls, transaction verification, account safeguarding, and incident communication.
* Coordinate with other banks, payment service providers, and financial institutions under AFCM protocols to support recovery and interbank fraud response.
* Act as an escalation point for all complex, high risk, or sensitive fraud cases, particularly those occurring outside normal business hours.
* Maintain effective working relationships with:

+ Group Operations
+ Digital & Retail Banking
+ IT / Information Security
+ Payments Teams
+ Call Centre and Customer Care functions

* Serve as a point of contact for regulators, law enforcement, and MOI, particularly for urgent or after hours fraud matters.
* Ensure accurate, timely, and consistent responses to regulators within required timeframes.
* Support subsidiaries and international branches by providing advisory guidance on fraud operations, fraud system issues, escalation handling, and response standards.
* Liaise with Information Security personnel on issues pertaining to enhancements in, and problem-resolution of the Enterprise Fraud Management system
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn-around time.
* Internal (Process, Products, Regulatory)
* Maintain a robust governance framework for Non-Card Fraud Operations, including:

+ Escalation matrices
+ Decision making authorities
+ Maker checker controls
+ On call and contingency arrangements

* Ensure that all fraud incidents detected through EFMS or reported through operational channels are logged, assessed, escalated, and tracked to closure.
* Oversee the interface between outsourced fraud monitoring analysts and permanent staff, ensuring clear role segregation and accountability.
* Ensure outsourced staff operate strictly within defined authority limits, with restricted actions reserved for permanent staff.
* Support the development, review, and maintenance of operational procedures, response playbooks and AFCM communication templates.
* Support to monitor regulatory developments (local and international) impacting fraud operations and ensure timely updates to procedures and controls.
* Provide regular reporting to the Vice President – Fraud Assurance & Strategy and Vice President Fraud Investigations and Monitoring on fraud trends, operational incidents, control effectiveness and residual risks and remediation actions.
* Support Internal Audit, QCB examinations, and external audits by providing evidence of continuous monitoring, response actions, and governance oversight.
* Provide analysis on the performance of parameters to support management in ensuring the appropriateness of rules in response to emerging or previously undetected suspicious and fraudulent behavior, recommending changes or enhancements where necessary.
* Identify on timely basis, the regulatory changes (locally / International) that impact the Group’s compliance risk to enable timely update of the referenced charter, plan and policy manuals.
* Forward all internal fraud suspicious incidents to the fraud investigations team for appropriate investigations.
* Take necessary actions to ensure all the new issued policies and procedures (when applicable) are embedded with appropriate key controls for fraud prevention and detection.
* Provide real-time ad hoc corrective actions and compliance advisory oversight for all business lines.
* Participate in issuing the studies, manuals on the new regulations, international standards, etc.
* Maintain an updated inventory of suspected risk events, their status, impact and actions taken.
* Defining and documenting mitigating controls and linking them to identified fraud risks.
* Suggest amendments to the existing controls, designing and implementing new preventive and detective controls as necessary, and implementing supporting technologies.
* Implementing technology to aid in continuous monitoring and detection activities.
* Learning & Knowledge:
* Ensure that fraud operations staff (permanent and outsourced) maintain appropriate skills and experience, in line with QCB expectations.
* Contribute to the design and delivery of fraud operations training programs, including real time response procedures, escalation handling, customer engagement during fraud incidents.
* Promote a strong fraud risk and compliance culture across the Group.
* Stay abreast of emerging fraud typologies, regulatory expectations, and international best practices.
* Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of fraud detection and response capabilities.
* Assist the Vice President of Fraud Assurance and Strategy in facilitating an organizational Compliance Culture throughout the Group which reflects a commitment to compliance with the related laws and regulations.
* Assist in preparing the yearly training program to cover QNB Group Staff members;
* Participate in developing, and coordinating in a multifaceted educational and training program and seeks to ensure that all appropriate employees and management are knowledgeable of, and comply with, applicable laws and regulations.
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML & CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defense principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.

**Education/Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Banking, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in a major financial institution or consulting firm, including, at least 4 years in fraud operations, fraud risk management or call center management.
* Demonstrated experience in fraud operations, investigations, or real time monitoring.
* Strong understanding of fraud typologies, digital fraud risks, and payment fraud.
* Experience with enterprise fraud monitoring systems and real time alert handling.
* Decision making ability under time critical conditions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High integrity, resilience, and ability to operate effectively.

Note: you will be required to attach the following:

* Copy of QID

Title: Program Management Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
**Program Manager - Operations Manager – Oracle Health Cloud Infrastructure & Disaster Recovery**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated
**Operations Manager**
to lead a team responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, client disaster recovery environments, operational project delivery, and enterprise healthcare technology solutions.
  
  
This position combines
**people leadership, cloud operations, project management, and client relationship management**
. The successful candidate will oversee a team of operations associates while actively participating in the coordination, provisioning, maintenance, and support of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments, CareAware cloud solutions, and infrastructure supporting Oracle Health applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on operational leader who can manage multiple competing priorities, coordinate complex infrastructure projects, communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure the successful delivery of cloud services to healthcare clients.
  
  
**Candidates with experience supporting Cerner Millennium Electronic Health Record (EHR) environments are strongly preferred.**
Familiarity with Millennium infrastructure, healthcare application dependencies, client upgrades, and the operational requirements of mission-critical healthcare systems will be particularly valuable.
  
  
This role requires someone comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with operational execution, including cloud resource provisioning, network configuration requests, disaster recovery coordination, infrastructure troubleshooting, and healthcare application support coordination.
  
  
***This role will be based in Nashville TN - we do offer relocation assistance***
**Responsibilities**
**People Management & Team Leadership**

* Provide direct management, coaching, mentoring, and professional development for a team of approximately 8 operations associates.
* Manage day-to-day team operations, including workload distribution, project assignments, support responsibilities, and resource planning.
* Establish, maintain, and coordinate on-call rotations to ensure appropriate coverage for production environments, critical infrastructure, and client support needs.
* Monitor team capacity and priorities to ensure project commitments and operational support obligations are met.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance evaluations, development discussions, and team meetings.
* Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to project managers and operations associates.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team.
* Coordinate escalations, remove operational blockers, and ensure critical issues receive appropriate attention and resolution.

**Disaster Recovery Operations & Client Project Management**

* Lead and coordinate client disaster recovery (DR) infrastructure projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, and ongoing operational support.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders regarding disaster recovery environments, project timelines, infrastructure requirements, and operational readiness.
* Facilitate recurring weekly client meetings to review DR environment health, project progress, outstanding issues, upcoming changes, and operational priorities.
* Provide regular status reports, project updates, risk assessments, and action-item tracking for client disaster recovery environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and application teams to ensure disaster recovery environments meet established operational requirements.
* Oversee infrastructure provisioning, configuration requests, maintenance activities, and environment readiness.
* Track project milestones, dependencies, infrastructure issues, and deliverables using Jira and other project management tools.
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing and validation activities with appropriate operations teams and client stakeholders.
* Identify risks and escalate issues that could impact client recovery capabilities, service availability, or project timelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of DR environments, infrastructure configurations, client requirements, and operational procedures.
* Coordinate disaster recovery planning and operational readiness activities for environments supporting healthcare applications, including Cerner Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions, where applicable.

**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Administration & Operations**

* Utilize the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Console and associated tools to support provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure resources.
* Provision and manage OCI compute instances, including virtual machine creation, configuration, and deployment activities.
* Coordinate and implement network Access Control List (ACL) and Network Security Group (NSG) requests in accordance with established security and change management procedures.
* Support virtual cloud network (VCN) configurations, subnet assignments, and network connectivity requirements.
* Perform basic network troubleshooting within the OCI Console, including reviewing security rules, routing configurations, subnet settings, and connectivity-related issues.
* Collaborate with networking, virtualization, DevOps, and infrastructure operations teams to investigate and resolve cloud infrastructure issues.
* Assist with infrastructure upgrades, migrations, resource changes, and environment maintenance activities.
* Ensure cloud infrastructure changes are appropriately documented, tracked, and communicated to affected stakeholders.
* Support operational best practices for infrastructure reliability, security, availability, and disaster recovery readiness.

**Oracle Health & Cerner Millennium EHR Operations**

* Support the coordination and operational management of infrastructure and cloud environments associated with Oracle Health applications, including Cerner Millennium EHR and CareAware solutions.
* Work with Oracle Health application teams, infrastructure operations, networking, and client stakeholders to coordinate environment provisioning, upgrades, migrations, and operational support activities.
* Apply knowledge of Cerner Millennium environments and healthcare application dependencies to identify potential infrastructure risks and coordinate appropriate resolution.
* Assist in planning and coordinating infrastructure changes that may affect Millennium-connected applications, integrations, or supporting healthcare services.
* Collaborate with application owners and operations teams to support availability, reliability, and continuity of mission-critical healthcare systems.
* Coordinate client communications, project timelines, and operational readiness activities for infrastructure initiatives involving Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the importance of minimizing service disruptions in healthcare environments and maintaining appropriate operational controls during infrastructure changes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to investigate infrastructure-related issues affecting healthcare applications and coordinate escalations through resolution.

**Operational Project & Service Delivery Management**

* Oversee multiple concurrent operational initiatives involving cloud infrastructure, application migrations, client upgrades, disaster recovery, and service improvements.
* Assign and prioritize project work and support Jira tickets based on business needs, operational complexity, resource availability, and client commitments.
* Coordinate across product engineering, networking, virtualization, DevOps, consulting, and client-facing teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Lead infrastructure modernization and migration initiatives, including operating system upgrades and legacy server replacement.
* Work with client stakeholders to establish migration timelines, resolve dependencies, and encourage timely adoption of supported infrastructure platforms.
* Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, third-party licensing expenses, operational overhead, and infrastructure-related risks.
* Maintain project schedules, action items, risks, dependencies, and status communications.
* Support both planned project activities and unplanned operational escalations while maintaining clear priorities and accountability.
* Coordinate infrastructure and application modernization efforts within healthcare environments while considering operational dependencies and client service continuity.

**Process Improvement, Jira Management & Documentation**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Jira workflows, issue templates, project templates, and operational tracking processes.
* Create standardized project and support request templates to improve consistency, visibility, and execution efficiency.
* Establish repeatable procedures for client onboarding, cloud provisioning, infrastructure requests, disaster recovery support, and project delivery.
* Improve coordination between account managers, project managers, operations associates, and engineering teams.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative or operational tasks.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and project records.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase team productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve client service delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in IT operations, infrastructure management, cloud services, service delivery, or a related operational leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or mentoring operations professionals.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent infrastructure and operational initiatives.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts, including virtual machines, compute resources, networking, and infrastructure provisioning.
* Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or a comparable enterprise cloud platform.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, subnets, routing, ACLs, security groups, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating client-facing operational projects and communicating with diverse stakeholders.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery concepts, infrastructure availability, business continuity, and operational support processes.
* Experience using Jira or similar platforms for project tracking, support ticket management, and workload assignment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and escalation management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead client meetings and provide clear operational project updates.
* Ability to balance strategic team management responsibilities with hands-on infrastructure and operational work.
* Understanding of operational change management and service availability requirements in enterprise production environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Oracle Health and Cerner Millennium Experience**

* Experience supporting Cerner Millennium EHR environments is strongly preferred, particularly in infrastructure operations, application support coordination, upgrades, migrations, or disaster recovery.
* Familiarity with the Cerner Millennium ecosystem, including its supporting infrastructure, application dependencies, and integration with other Oracle Health solutions.
* Experience working within Oracle Health, Cerner, or comparable enterprise healthcare technology environments.
* Understanding of the operational requirements associated with supporting mission-critical EHR systems in hospital or health system environments.
* Experience coordinating infrastructure changes, maintenance activities, or application upgrades affecting Cerner Millennium environments.
* Familiarity with CareAware applications and their integration or operational dependencies within the broader Oracle Health ecosystem.
* Experience collaborating with healthcare client IT departments, application support teams, infrastructure teams, and implementation stakeholders.
* Knowledge of healthcare IT service availability, business continuity, change management, and disaster recovery considerations.

**Cloud Infrastructure And Operational Experience**

* Direct experience administering or supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute instances, virtual cloud networks, subnets, security lists, and network security groups.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery infrastructure planning, testing, failover coordination, and environment maintenance.
* Experience managing cloud appliance procurement, hardware deployment, or vendor coordination.
* Experience working with HPE infrastructure or enterprise hardware vendors.
* Knowledge of Windows Server infrastructure, operating system migrations, virtualization, and server lifecycle management.
* Experience collaborating with DevOps, network operations, virtualization operations, and application development teams.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, change management, incident management, and production support operations.
* Experience developing Jira templates, workflow improvements, infrastructure documentation, and standardized operational processes.
* Experience coordinating operational projects across geographically distributed teams and international client environments.
* Relevant cloud, infrastructure, project management, or IT service management certifications are a plus.

**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Operational Leadership:**
Ability to lead operations associates, assign work effectively, mentor team members, and maintain operational accountability.
  
  
**Cloud Infrastructure Operations:**
Working knowledge of OCI, compute provisioning, virtual networking, infrastructure operations, and basic troubleshooting.
  
  
**Disaster Recovery Management:**
Ability to coordinate client DR projects, manage environment readiness, communicate operational status, and organize recovery activities.
  
  
**Healthcare Application Awareness:**
Understanding of the operational demands of enterprise healthcare applications, particularly Cerner Millennium EHR, CareAware, and related Oracle Health solutions.
  
  
**Project Execution:**
Strong planning, prioritization, tracking, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  
  
**Client Communication:**
Confidence leading client-facing operational meetings, managing expectations, and communicating risks, issues, and project progress.
  
  
**Operational Excellence:**
Commitment to improving support processes, documentation, service reliability, and team efficiency.
  
  
**Problem Solving:**
Ability to assess infrastructure and operational challenges, coordinate appropriate resources, and drive timely resolution.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to:
  
  

* Maintain a well-organized, effective operations team with clear ownership of projects, support responsibilities, and on-call coverage.
* Successfully coordinate and deliver client disaster recovery projects while maintaining reliable ongoing support of DR environments.
* Ensure timely completion of OCI compute provisioning, network security requests, and infrastructure configuration activities.
* Build strong working relationships with clients, internal engineering teams, project managers, and external vendors.
* Effectively coordinate infrastructure and operational initiatives supporting Oracle Health applications, including Cerner Millennium and CareAware environments.
* Apply an understanding of healthcare application dependencies to proactively identify operational risks and minimize disruptions to client services.
* Improve the efficiency and consistency of Jira project management, operational workflows, and support processes.
* Proactively identify and resolve risks that could affect infrastructure availability, project delivery, or client satisfaction.
* Balance people management, infrastructure execution, and project leadership to support the continued growth and reliability of cloud-based healthcare solutions.

**Ideal Candidate**
We are looking for a
**hands-on Operations Manager who enjoys staying involved in day-to-day cloud infrastructure and service delivery operations**
.
  
  
This individual should be equally comfortable coaching team members, leading a client disaster recovery meeting, coordinating a complex infrastructure deployment, assigning Jira work, or navigating the OCI Console to provision compute resources and investigate basic networking issues.
  
  
**An especially strong candidate will bring previous experience working with Cerner Millennium EHR environments**
, providing valuable insight into the infrastructure dependencies, operational challenges, and service continuity expectations associated with supporting enterprise healthcare applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a combination of leadership, operational expertise, organizational discipline, healthcare industry awareness, and strong client communication skills. They take ownership of challenges, proactively remove obstacles, and continuously look for ways to improve how operations teams deliver services.

Title: Lead Imaging Consultant
Description:
**Position Description:**

The Lead Imaging Consultant is responsible for providing technical leadership, application governance, implementation oversight, optimization, and operational support for enterprise clinical imaging systems across American Hospital Dubai. The position ensures that imaging systems are secure, available, interoperable, clinically effective, and aligned with patient care, operational, regulatory, and digital transformation requirements.

**Position Responsibility:**

Imaging Systems Leadership and Governance

* Leads the technical administration, configuration, integration, maintenance, and optimization of PACS, RIS, VNA, enterprise viewers, image exchange platforms, voice recognition solutions, advanced visualization tools, and other clinical imaging applications.
* Establishes imaging system standards, operating procedures, governance controls, service expectations, and technology roadmaps in alignment with clinical priorities, enterprise architecture, and organizational strategy.
* Serves as the senior technical and functional subject matter expert for clinical imaging systems, advising IT leadership and clinical stakeholders on platform capability, system design, integration, optimization, and technology investment.
* Coordinates the imaging applications support function, provide technical direction to analysts and vendors, and ensure issues are appropriately prioritized, investigated, escalated, and resolved.

Clinical Workflow and Systems Optimization

* Analyzes end-to-end imaging workflows from order entry and patient scheduling through modality acquisition, image interpretation, reporting, distribution, archiving, and clinical review.
* Collaborates with radiologists, cardiologists, technologists, nurses, physicians, and operational leaders to translate clinical requirements into safe, standardized, and efficient system workflows.
* Leads optimization initiatives addressing modality worklists, patient and study reconciliation, hanging protocols, report distribution, critical-results communication, image availability, turnaround time, and diagnostic user experience.
* Evaluate system enhancement requests, identify workflow risks and dependencies, and recommend solutions that improve patient safety, clinical productivity, service quality, and operational performance.

Integration and Interoperability

* Oversees DICOM, HL7, FHIR, IHE, and API-based integration between imaging platforms, modalities, the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), clinical systems, reporting solutions, patient portals, and external health information exchanges.
* Coordinates onboarding, testing, validation, and production deployment of imaging modalities and systems, ensuring correct patient identification, order matching, data exchange, image routing, and clinical availability.
* Manage imaging data migration, consolidation, lifecycle management, and archive strategies while ensuring data integrity, accessibility, retention, and continuity of historical patient information.
* Support secure exchange of imaging records with external providers and regulatory platforms, including applicable NABIDH integration and organizational interoperability requirements.
* Ensures all clinical systems training aligns with JCI standards, International Patient Safety Goals (IPSG), DHA regulations, and hospital policies.

Implementation, Testing and Change Management

* Leads imaging technology projects including new implementations, upgrades, migrations, integrations, replacements, expansions, and activation of new clinical locations or imaging services.
* Develops functional and technical requirements, implementation plans, risk assessments, test scripts, validation criteria, cutover plans, downtime procedures, and post-go-live support arrangements.
* Coordinates unit, integration, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, ensuring clinical workflows and patient safety requirements are validated before production deployment.
* Maintains controlled change-management processes and ensure all configuration changes, releases, interfaces, and system enhancements are appropriately reviewed, approved, documented, tested, and communicated.

Service Reliability and Technical Support

* Monitors system availability, interface performance, storage capacity, image-routing queues, application performance, database health, and service trends to maintain reliable 24/7 imaging operations.
* Leads investigation and resolution of complex incidents involving missing images, mismatched studies, patient identity errors, failed interfaces, modality connectivity, reporting interruptions, archive retrieval, and application performance.
* Coordinates with infrastructure, database, networking, cybersecurity, Biomedical Engineering, vendors, and clinical teams during critical incidents, planned maintenance, downtime, and system recovery.
* Maintains support escalation procedures, knowledge resources, service documentation, and on-call readiness to minimize disruption to diagnostic and clinical services.

Data Security, Compliance and Business Continuity

* Collaborates with Information Security to manage access controls, privileged accounts, audit logs, vulnerability remediation, secure image exchange, encryption, third-party access, and cybersecurity risks affecting connected imaging systems and modalities.
* Develops, tests, and maintains imaging-system business continuity, disaster recovery, downtime, backup, restoration, and high-availability procedures in coordination with infrastructure and clinical stakeholders.
* Supports accreditation surveys, regulatory inspections, internal audits, risk assessments, and corrective action plans related to clinical imaging technology, information management, and patient safety.

Vendor, Asset and Financial Coordination

* Manages technical relationships with imaging-system vendors, service providers, modality suppliers, and implementation partners, ensuring contractual obligations, support services, response times, and deliverables are achieved.
* Contributes to business cases, technical evaluations, requests for proposal, vendor selection, contract reviews, capital expenditure planning, licensing forecasts, storage projections, and total-cost-of-ownership assessments.
* Maintains an accurate inventory of imaging applications, interfaces, licenses, devices, software versions, dependencies, support agreements, certificates, and planned lifecycle replacements.
* Reviews vendor performance, recurring incidents, system utilization, licensing, maintenance costs, and improvement opportunities to support responsible technology investment.

Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement

* Establishes and monitors imaging technology performance indicators covering availability, incident response, interface reliability, image accessibility, report turnaround support, storage utilization, user satisfaction, project delivery, and system optimization.
* Analyzes service data, user feedback, recurring incidents, workflow delays, capacity trends, and audit findings to identify and implement sustainable improvements.
* Prepares operational reports, project updates, risk summaries, technology recommendations, and performance dashboards for IT and clinical leadership.
* Participates in clinical informatics governance, imaging committees, digital transformation initiatives, quality improvement programs, and other organizational projects as assigned.

**Position Qualification:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Health Informatics, Medical Imaging, Radiologic Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Health Informatics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Digital Health, or a related field preferred.
* Professional certification or formal training in PACS administration, imaging informatics, DICOM, HL7, healthcare integration, project management, cybersecurity, or relevant vendor technologies is preferred.
* Current or previous professional registration in Radiologic Technology or another clinical imaging discipline is advantageous.
* Advanced knowledge of PACS, RIS, VNA, enterprise viewers, modality worklists, voice recognition, image exchange, advanced visualization, and imaging workflow.
* Strong knowledge of DICOM, HL7, FHIR, IHE Radiology integration profiles, healthcare interfaces, image lifecycle management, and clinical-system interoperability.
* Knowledge of imaging infrastructure, storage, virtualization, cloud architecture, networking, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, database concepts, and system monitoring.
* Strong understanding of radiology and other clinical imaging workflows, patient identity management, clinical documentation, privacy, patient safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent leadership, consultation, analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, project management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, and provide support in a high-availability healthcare environment.

**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in imaging informatics, PACS/RIS administration, clinical systems, healthcare information technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of two (2) years in a senior imaging systems, lead consultant, solution architect, PACS administrator, or equivalent role within a complex healthcare environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing, integrating, upgrading, migrating, and supporting enterprise PACS, RIS, VNA, diagnostic viewing, and imaging workflow solutions.
* Experience supporting radiology and at least one additional imaging specialty such as cardiology, breast imaging, nuclear medicine, oncology, dental imaging, endoscopy, or digital pathology is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with DICOM and HL7 integration, modality onboarding, image migration, workflow optimization, incident resolution, vendor management, and business continuity planning.
* Experience integrating imaging artificial intelligence or advanced clinical decision-support solutions is highly desirable.
* Experience within a tertiary, multi-site, or JCI-accredited hospital and familiarity with DHA and NABIDH requirements are preferred.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary projects and working directly with physicians, radiologists, technologists, executives, technical teams, and external vendors is required.

**About the Opportunity:**

CarltonOne is seeking a highly motivated Director, Information Technology to lead CarltonOne's global enterprise IT function, owning IT strategy, service management, governance, and employee technology experience.

This role is responsible for delivering a best-in-class employee technology experience across the organization, ensuring employees have the tools, systems, support, and infrastructure they need to be productive and successful. The Director, IT will lead internal IT support, service delivery, endpoint management, identity and access management, collaboration tools, workplace technology initiatives, and global hardware operations across CarltonOne's international workforce.

This is a strategic leadership role. The Director, IT is accountable for the outcomes of IT service delivery rather than working the support queue, leading through managers, team leads, and managed service partners who handle Level 1 and Level 2 support. The Director serves as the senior escalation point and leader during major IT and security incidents, and focuses on strengthening process, governance, and measurement to deliver an exceptional, proactive employee experience. The successful candidate will focus on improving service levels, modernizing IT processes, strengthening security practices, and scaling internal technology operations to support a growing global organization.

**Responsibilities:**

**IT Service Management & Incident Leadership**

* Own CarltonOne's global IT operating model, including service desk structure, tiered support (L1/L2/L3), escalation paths, and the balance of in-house and managed service provider (MSP) coverage.
* Hold the service desk and support partners accountable for timely, high-quality resolution of employee requests and issues, without personally working day-to-day L1/L2 tickets.
* Define and publish SLAs, experience level agreements (XLAs), and an IT performance scorecard covering CSAT, first-contact resolution, mean time to resolve, SLA attainment, backlog age, and reopen rates, reported monthly to executive leadership.
* Run a continuous improvement program driven by ticket trend analysis, employee feedback, and experience data, with the goal of reducing ticket volume per employee year over year.
* Ensure consistent delivery of IT services across all regions and time zones.
* Act as Major Incident Manager and senior escalation point for high-impact IT outages, leading coordinated response, stakeholder communications, and service restoration.
* Partner with Information Security to support the response to security incidents, including containment of affected accounts and devices, evidence preservation, and executive communication, in line with the incident response plan.
* Implement a problem management practice that uses root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to eliminate recurring issues, with tracked corrective actions.
* Establish change, release, and configuration management processes that reduce change-related incidents and protect service stability.
* Own Jira Service Management as the IT service management platform, driving workflow design, automation, SLA tracking, and reporting.
* Partner with SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams to align IT processes such as access, change, and incident management with production operations, and provide the internal tools and access they need.
* Own the IT service management (ITSM) platform roadmap, service catalogue, and knowledge base, aligned to ITIL 4 practices.

**Employee Technology Experience**

* Develop and enhance the overall employee technology experience across the organization.
* Ensure employees have access to reliable hardware, software, collaboration tools, and support resources regardless of location.
* Partner with business leaders to understand technology needs and improve workplace productivity.
* Evaluate and implement technologies that improve employee efficiency, collaboration, and engagement.
* Champion self-service support resources, knowledge management programs, and technology adoption initiatives.
* Shift IT from reactive to proactive by using monitoring, digital employee experience (DEX) tooling, and endpoint analytics to detect and resolve issues before employees are affected.
* Measure employee technology sentiment through regular surveys and an IT Net Promoter Score, and act on the results with visible follow-through.
* Promote a shift-left approach that moves common requests to self-service and automation, freeing the team for higher-value work.
* Create seamless onboarding and offboarding experiences through standardized technology processes.

**Global Hardware & Employee Technology Management**

* Own CarltonOne's global hardware procurement, deployment, lifecycle management, and asset governance strategy.
* Develop and manage scalable processes for onboarding and offboarding employees across Canada, the United States, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Australia, and other international locations.
* Partner with global vendors, distributors, and logistics providers to ensure timely delivery, replacement, retrieval, and support of employee equipment worldwide.
* Establish global standards for laptops, peripherals, mobile devices, and collaboration technology to provide a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee hardware inventory management, asset tracking, auditing, and recovery programs across all regions.
* Manage relationships with international hardware partners and service providers to optimize cost, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Develop regional technology deployment strategies that account for customs requirements, shipping timelines, local regulations, and business needs.
* Ensure all employee devices are properly configured, secured, encrypted, and compliant with company security standards prior to deployment.
* Partner with Information Security teams to maintain endpoint management, device compliance, and security controls globally.
* Lead technology refresh programs and lifecycle planning to ensure employees have access to modern and reliable equipment.
* Establish reporting and KPIs related to deployment timelines, inventory accuracy, hardware utilization, asset recovery, and employee satisfaction.

**IT Leadership & Talent**

* Build, lead, and develop a global IT organization, including people managers, team leads, and specialists, and manage MSP and outsourced support partners.
* Establish team goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
* Foster a customer-first service culture focused on responsiveness, accountability, and problem resolution.
* Design staffing models, global coverage, escalation processes, and on-call rotations so that routine support across all time zones is delivered by the team and its partners.
* Promote knowledge sharing, process consistency, and operational excellence across the team.
* Build a high-performing IT organization capable of supporting a rapidly growing global workforce.

**Infrastructure & Workplace Technology**

* Oversee the management of employee technology including laptops, mobile devices, conference room systems, printers, and collaboration tools.
* Ensure reliable operation of corporate productivity platforms including Microsoft 365, communication platforms, and workplace technologies.
* Support office technology infrastructure across multiple global locations.
* Own software licensing and SaaS governance, including licence optimization, application rationalization, and shadow IT controls.
* Identify opportunities to modernize and standardize workplace technology solutions.

**Identity, Access Management & IT Security**

* Oversee user provisioning, deprovisioning, and identity and access management processes.
* Partner closely with Information Security teams to maintain secure access controls and endpoint security standards.
* Support security awareness initiatives and IT compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to IT policies, security best practices, and governance standards.
* Participate in internal and external audits related to IT operations and controls.
* Help strengthen the company's security posture through proactive management of employee technology and access controls.

**Vendor & Technology Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, service providers, telecommunications partners, and technology suppliers.
* Negotiate contracts, licensing agreements, and support arrangements.
* Evaluate technology investments and recommend solutions that align with business requirements and budgets.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure service commitments are achieved.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate vendors and improve operational efficiency.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Lead enterprise IT projects from planning through implementation and ongoing support.
* Support technology rollouts, infrastructure upgrades, collaboration platform enhancements, and automation initiatives.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Security, Operations, and Technology teams on cross-functional projects.
* Develop project plans, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive automation and process improvement initiatives that increase productivity and reduce manual effort.

**IT Strategy, Governance, Risk & Business Continuity**

* Develop and own a multi-year IT strategy and roadmap aligned to CarltonOne's business objectives and growth plans.
* Own the IT operating and capital budget, with clear reporting on spend, cost per employee, and return on technology investments, including the cost, utilization, and value of software, SaaS, and AI tools.
* Manage IT expenses through SAP Concur, ensuring policy compliance, accurate cost allocation, and timely financial reporting.
* Establish and maintain IT operational policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Chair IT governance forums, such as a change advisory board and a technology steering committee, to prioritize demand and investment.
* Ensure compliance with corporate requirements, security policies, and audit standards, including ownership of IT general controls (ITGCs) and implementation and continuous compliance with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Critical Security Controls, and SOC 2, including audit readiness, evidence collection, and remediation of findings.
* Maintain accurate documentation of systems, assets, processes, and support procedures.
* Own disaster recovery planning and regular testing for internal systems and employee technologies, and partner with the business on continuity planning.
* Maintain an IT risk register, report key risks to leadership, and own mitigation plans through to closure.

**Qualifications:**

* **10+ years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years in IT leadership, with experience managing managers and/or managed service partners.**
* Experience leading internal IT operations, service desk, workplace technology, or enterprise support teams.
* Experience leading internal IT within a SaaS company, including supporting SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams with access management, tooling, change coordination, and incident collaboration.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and modern workplace technologies.
* Proven experience managing global hardware deployment and asset lifecycle programs.
* Experience supporting distributed workforces across multiple countries and time zones.
* Expert in ITIL 4 and IT service management (ITSM), with a proven record of designing, implementing, and maturing incident, problem, change, request, and knowledge management processes.
* Hands-on experience implementing and administering Jira Service Management, including workflows, service catalogue, SLAs, automation, and reporting.
* Proven experience implementing and improving controls aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Critical Security Controls, and SOC 2, including audit readiness, evidence collection, remediation of findings, and ongoing compliance.
* Proven track record leading major incident response and partnering with security teams on security incident response.
* Demonstrated use of data, KPIs, and experience metrics to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Proven experience owning and managing an IT budget, including forecasting, variance tracking, and reporting to leadership on the financial performance and return on investment of software, SaaS, and AI tool spend.
* Experience using SAP Concur for IT expense management, including expense policy, approvals, and spend reporting.
* Experience managing vendors, software licensing, and technology procurement.
* Proven experience leading IT projects and operational improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Strong customer service mindset with a focus on employee experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a global workforce across North America, South America, Europe, and APAC.
* Experience with IT governance and control frameworks such as COBIT, ISO 27001, or ISO 20000.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, endpoint security, and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting HRIS, Finance, and SaaS business applications.
* ITIL 4, Atlassian (Jira Service Management), Microsoft, CISSP, CISM, or related certifications.

**Additional Perks**

Here are some additional perks that we provide:

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Vacation plus personal days.
* Access to our employee benefits portal for exclusive discounts.
* Monthly company-wide events, celebrations, and team activities.
* Bravo reward points program for recognition and appreciation.
* Convenient office location close to public transit.

**How to Apply**

If this great opportunity looks rewarding to you, let’s connect. Our online application will give you the option to apply to this role directly.

The target hiring range for this position is $115,000 to $135,000 Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified people to apply. If we can make this easier through accommodation in the recruitment process, or if you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact us with the “Help” button in the application.

We will review applications, with priority given to those who have completed the assessment, and look forward to hearing from you.

Title: Director, Technology, Campana Systems
Description:
**We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this** **link** **directly.**

  

**Who we are**

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

**About Campana Systems**

Campana Systems, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized software solutions for AAA and CAA auto clubs across North America. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario, Campana has built long-standing relationships with organizations that rely on its technology to manage their operations and deliver services to their members.

Our AXIS platform brings together membership management, customer relationship management, emergency roadside assistance, travel services, and business intelligence in an integrated suite of solutions. Looking ahead, we are focused on evolving our technology, strengthening our platform capabilities, and finding new ways to help our customers work more efficiently and deliver better member experiences.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director, Technology to lead the evolution of Campana Systems’ technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, and AXIS platform. In this newly created role, you will own the technology roadmap from strategy through execution, with accountability for modernization priorities, investment decisions, platform reliability, and measurable business outcomes. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, partner with the Director, Development, and establish the technical direction and capabilities needed to deliver on our product vision while supporting the customers who depend on our technology.

*This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Shape a meaningful transformation.* You will have the autonomy to challenge established approaches, make consequential technology decisions, and guide the evolution of a business-critical software platform. You will see the impact of your work in stronger platform capabilities, improved delivery, and better customer experiences.

*Build what comes next.* You will lead experienced teams while shaping the standards, capabilities, and ways of working needed for the future. From strengthening engineering practices to developing technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to build a more effective technology organization and see the results of your leadership.

*Grow your executive influence.* You will work directly with the General Manager and contribute to decisions that connect technology investments with customer needs and business growth. Backed by Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will have opportunities to expand your leadership experience and pursue broader responsibilities over time.

**As our new Director, Technology, you will**

* **Own the technology roadmap.** You will turn the product vision into a multi-year strategy with clear priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking accountability for delivery and results. You will establish architectural standards, technology governance, and engineering priorities. Partnering with the Director, Development, you will strengthen technical decision-making, CI/CD, automation, and delivery practices across Canadian and offshore teams.
* **Lead platform modernization.** You will define a phased approach to evolving AXIS, including its legacy Rocket UniVerse architecture. You will determine what to retain, integrate, replace, or modernize, guiding decisions on APIs, application architecture, CRM, data capabilities, and cloud or hybrid environments while protecting the reliability customers depend on.
* **Turn innovation into impact.** You will identify opportunities to improve CRM capabilities, business intelligence, reporting, and operational efficiency through AI, automation, and better use of data. You will evaluate feasibility and business value, establish priorities, and work with technical teams to turn promising initiatives into measurable results.
* **Strengthen security and reliability.** You will oversee infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
* **Build and grow technical capabilities.** You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and identify capability gaps. You will improve collaboration with Development and Product to ensure teams have the direction and support needed to execute the roadmap.
* **Connect technology to business priorities.** You will partner with the General Manager on technology investments, budgets, resources, and strategic decisions. You will communicate risks and trade-offs, measure progress, and contribute technical leadership to customer conversations when needed.

**You bring**

* **The senior technology leadership.** You have led technology strategy, architecture, and technical teams within an enterprise software business, with accountability for investment decisions, organizational performance, and business outcomes. You bring the judgment to set direction, establish priorities, and deliver results through technical leaders and cross-functional teams.
* **The platform modernization expertise.** You have led the evolution of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and customer dependencies. You know how to assess what to retain, replace, or integrate, develop a phased modernization roadmap, and introduce new capabilities without compromising reliability.
* **The technical depth.** You bring strong expertise in enterprise architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud or hybrid environments, along with an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. You can establish technical standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide decisions that strengthen platform performance, security, and scalability.
* **The experience driving innovation.** You have improved engineering practices and delivery performance across distributed teams, including those outside your direct reporting structure. You understand CI/CD, automation, and modern development practices, and can identify practical opportunities for AI, analytics, and business intelligence that deliver measurable value.
* **The business acumen.** You connect technology decisions to customer needs, financial priorities, and long-term business growth. You can evaluate investments, communicate complex trade-offs, and align senior leaders while staying close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions and guide execution.
* **The influence.** You develop strong technical leaders, establish accountability, and build cross-functional, cross-location collaboration. You are comfortable making difficult decisions, navigating competing priorities, and owning outcomes in an environment where you have the autonomy to shape what comes next.

**Why join?**

Axis Campana and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

**Compensation**

At Campana and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
* An interview with the General Manager to discuss your technology leadership experience, approach to platform modernization, architectural decision-making, and ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes.
* A final virtual interview with the Portfolio Manager and members of the technology leadership team to explore your approach to leading transformation, collaborating across teams, and building the capabilities needed to execute the technology roadmap.

Aquila and Campana Systems promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.
