Title: eTrading Engineering Lead
Description:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in Canada. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.
  
  
In Canada, HSBC Global Services (Canada) Limited (HGCA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Global Services Limited. Operating in Toronto, HGCA is part of a global service company, delivering services to support the operating entities of HSBC Group. We have different capabilities that provide tools and processes to facilitate the functions, business, and entities with their service management responsibilities.
  
  
**Ready to shape the infrastructure behind low-latency electronic trading platforms?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join Markets and Securities Services Information Technology (IT) as Regional Head of electronic Trading (eTrading) Infrastructure Engineering in Toronto, Canada. This role owns the regional infrastructure engineering capability supporting latency-sensitive and collocated electronic trading platforms. You’ll manage two infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on across data center compute, Linux, server hardware, network switching, and exchange connectivity. You’ll take end-to-end accountability for the regional infrastructure delivery pipeline aligned to agreed business priorities, alongside operational service performance and the regional risk and control agenda. Success means resilient, secure, and cost-effective services, strong control outcomes, and well-governed delivery across collocated data centers and exchange-facing infrastructure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee and develop two infrastructure engineers, setting objectives, allocating work, and building succession and capability plans
* Own the regional delivery pipeline and roadmap, translating business priorities into committed plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes while managing dependencies and trade-offs
* Manage the regional infrastructure budget, forecasts, and investment cases, controlling capital and operating expenditure and supplier and hardware lifecycle decisions
* Govern service availability, capacity, resilience, and support readiness, coordinating incident, problem, change, and recovery through to permanent remediation
* Own the regional risk and control environment, including technology risk assessment, audit and regulatory actions, security and firmware compliance, evidence quality, and timely issue closure
* Design, build, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure across collocated and enterprise data centers including Linux platforms, physical servers, network switches, cabling, out-of-band management, and low-latency connectivity
* Define and maintain regional reference architectures, engineering standards, design blueprints, build patterns, and operational procedures aligned with global strategy
* Build repeatable infrastructure delivery and validation pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing, contributing production-quality Java and Ansible code
* Stakeholder management: Partner with trading business, application engineering, architecture, cyber security, operations, risk, finance, procurement, vendors, exchanges and carriers to deliver regional outcomes.
* Regional execution: Lead data-centre builds, migrations, refreshes and exchange onboarding, coordinating suppliers and remote-hands teams and providing hands-on support during critical implementations and incidents.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial hands-on experience in infrastructure, network, or compute engineering with accountability for regional or business-critical services
* Manage a small engineering team, establishing priorities, assuring delivery, and developing technical capability
* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management
* Use strong knowledge of low-latency networking including Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing and switching, multicast, packet capture analysis, and exchange or market data connectivity
* Build continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows and automated, version-controlled infrastructure delivery aligned to a Network Development and Operations (NetDevOps) approach
* Apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to infrastructure and network engineering using repeatable lab and pre-production validation
* Write production code in Java, or bring equivalent demonstrable production coding experience in Python or a comparable language
* Build Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible including reusable roles and playbooks, automated testing, and integration into delivery pipelines
* Experience supporting electronic trading, market-data or other latency-sensitive financial services infrastructure.
* Professional network certification such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center, or equivalent depth of experience.
* Experience with Docker, Containerlab, Molecule, Jira, Confluence and CI platforms such as TeamCity.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!
  
  
The final fixed pay offer will depend on the candidate and a number of variables, including but not limited to, role responsibilities, skill set, depth of experience and education, licensing/certification requirements, internal relativity, and specific work location.

Title: IT Regional Manager, Canada
Description:
TI Automotive supplies safety and performance critical products and highly engineered components to the global automotive industry. We have more than 100 years' experience of solving customers' safety, efficiency and environmental challenges. Our exceptional team, powertrain agnostic product portfolio, vertical integration, global footprint and customer proximity make us a trusted partner to all the world's leading OEMs.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an IT Regional Manager, Canada, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing the IT Operations infrastructure within the Canadian region. You will ensure that all IT systems, networks, and services across the Company's Canadian facilities are optimized, secure, and aligned with organizational goals. You will oversee a team of IT professionals and collaborate with local and global IT teams to ensure successful integration of IT solutions.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute an IT roadmap for Canada, ensure timely and efficient implementation of new systems, updates, and technologies.
* Work alongside Senior Management to ensure IT strategies are aligned with business goals and regional needs.
* Lead IT projects for the Canadian region, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and meet specific goals.
* Oversee change management process for new technology implementations, ensuring smooth transitions and user adoption.
* Oversee the regional IT budget, ensuring cost-effective technology investments, and staying within financial constraints.
* Manage the regional IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage, and communication systems.
* Ensure continuous monitoring and maintenance of IT systems, with a focus on maximizing uptime and performance of business-critical systems.
* Lead the implementation of digital transformation initiatives within Canadian operations, including automation and IoT solutions.
* Manage relationships with IT vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring contracts and service agreements align with IT needs and requirements. Participate in contract negotiations, if required.
* Work closely with other departments to identify IT needs and ensure regional IT solutions.
* Ensure implementation of IT security policies and procedures to protect organizational data, systems, and intellectual property.
* Oversee disaster recovery and business continuity plans, ensuring that systems can be restored timely in the event of failures.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of IT professionals by setting performance goals, conducting regular evaluations, and providing feedback/development opportunities.
* Provide regular updates to senior leadership on regional IT performance, key projects, and challenges.
* Continuously assess and improve IT processes and services, enhancing efficiency, reducing costs, and boosting overall effectiveness.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications, such as ITIL or Microsoft is beneficial.
* Minimum 5-8 years experience in IT operations, or a related role. Minimum 3 years experience in a leadership or management role.
* Proven experience with large-scale IT deployments, system migrations, or IT infrastructure upgrades.
* Prior experience managing, leading, and mentoring a team of IT professionals.
* Prior experience managing IT operations across multiple locations or regions is beneficial.
* Extensive experience in managing IT infrastructure (servers, networks, storage, etc.) and ensuring that these systems are reliable and secure.
* Experience leading IT change management processes, ensuring smooth transitions during technology upgrades, implementations, or system migrations.
* Experience in managing relationships with IT vendors, negotiating contracts, and ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and security measures (firewalls, VPNs, encryption) to ensure secure, reliable connectivity across regional operations.
* Sound knowledge of backup and disaster recovery planning, ensuring that critical data and systems can be restored in case of failure.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple IT projects, prioritize resources, track timelines, and ensure projects are completed within scope and budget.
* Ability to align regional IT strategies with overall business goals, ensuring that IT investments and initiatives are in line with company priorities.
* Familiarity with manufacturing and/or automotive industries, including the specific IT requirements, challenges, and technologies used.

**Why TI Automotive?**
**Benefits**
In addition to a workplace that emphasizes respect, teamwork and personal and professional growth, TI Automotive offers a broad range of health, wellness and financial benefits that promote the physical, mental and financial wellbeing of our employees and help them bring their best self to work, including:
  
  

* Competitive compensation package
* Competitive PTO Package

* RRSP/DPSP Company Match
* Educational Assistance Program
* Perkopolis Program
* Vehicle Purchase Discounts

Title: Technical Solution Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.
  
  
At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.
  
  
Metrolinx's Innovation and Information Technology group supports female team members via "Go Tech Women" an affinity group for women in Information Technology, led by our Chief Information Officer.
  
  
If you enjoy technology and innovation, value diversity, appreciate work/balance and are looking for an opportunity to make a better world via public service, Metrolinx would like to hear from you!
  
  
Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Foundational Technology and Infrastructure, the Technical Solution Manager is responsible for performing Cloud Infrastructure and Data Centre design-build and leading teams performing the same. Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure includes but is not limited to Private Clouds, Public Clouds, Hybrid Clouds, Infrastructure-as-Code, Infrastructure-as-a-Service, Platform-as-a-Service and Software-as-a-Service.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**

* Designs and builds foundational technology and infrastructure solutions at scale (e.g. storage, compute, networking, backup, Database, Private Clouds, Public Clouds, Hybrid Clouds, Infrastructure-as-Code, Infrastructure-as-a-Service, Platform-as-a-Service and Software-as-a-Service).
* Collaborate with I&IT teams as a Solution Lead/Integrator to create and maintain Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure architecture and detailed designs (conceptual, logical, integration and physical).
* Provides hands-on implementation or supports domain subject matter experts in validating designs for deployment, creating build documentation and other transition-to-operations artifacts.
* Works with the Cybersecurity team and ensures security resilience is designed and built into the Cloud Infrastructure solutions.
* Collaborate with I&IT teams to design and implement Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for the lifecycle of the Cloud Infrastructure and the overall solution stack.
* Assists stakeholders such as Solution Architects in designing solutions leveraging Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure.

Title: NERC CIP Program Director
Description:
**NERC CIP Program Director**

Have you built NERC CIP programs from the ground up, sat across the table from Regional Entity auditors, and thought, "I could do this better for a lot more entities"? Then we should talk. As Vertech's NERC CIP Program Director, you will build and lead our new NERC CIP compliance practice inside our Industrial Networking and Cybersecurity (INCS) Managed OT Security Services offering.

This is a builder's role. You will shape the services we offer, design how we deliver them, hire and lead the team, and own client compliance programs from registration through audit. You won't be doing it alone: our 24/7/365 OT Network and Security Operations Center already delivers the monitoring and recurring technical work behind CIP compliance. You bring the program and audit leadership that turns that work into audit-ready programs for utilities and renewable energy owners.

This position is remote, with regular travel to client sites, control centers, generation sites, and audits.

**Who We Are**

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top US companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. I mean, we call ourselves control freaks for a reason. The passion (and intelligence) our employees have is truly mind-blowing. In turn, we work hard to take care of our own with excellent benefits and pay, personal development, and transparent communication. We also know that you can be great at what you do and still have fun. If that sounds like a good fit, help us bring the next generation of automation solutions to industries including data centers, renewable energy, manufacturing, food and beverage, water and wastewater, and more.

Our Industrial Networking & Cybersecurity team helps clients assess, secure, modernize, and support Operational Technology environments, then protects them around the clock through our managed OT security services. NERC CIP compliance is the next service we're adding for the energy and renewable clients we already support.

**Top Reasons to Work with Us**

* Flexible work schedule with work from home options for many roles
* Weekly communication from management in our internally famous Friday morning meeting
* Competitive compensation including a bonus plan
* No more than a 4 week waiting period on all benefits including the 401k
* A really rad Christmas Party each year
* A manager that is cool…most of the time, because no one is perfect
* A path for growth, a great culture, PTO, AND MORE!

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build our NERC CIP practice: the service catalog, delivery model, methodologies, templates, policy libraries, and evidence frameworks
* Lead client CIP programs from end to end, from NERC and Regional Entity registration, CFRs, and CIP-002 categorization through policies, procedures, and internal controls across CIP-003 through CIP-013 and CIP-015
* Manage evidence collection and document management, RSAWs, self-certifications, and Evidence Request Tool submissions
* Run mock audits and gap analyses, and lead clients through Regional Entity audits
* Guide clients through enforcement, including self-reports, mitigation plans, and Regional Entity discussions
* Deliver supply chain risk management (CIP-013 and CIP-003 vendor remote access) and BES Cyber System Information protection (CIP-011) services
* Lead readiness work for upcoming requirements, including the CIP virtualization revisions and CIP-015 internal network security monitoring
* Serve as a Fractional CIP Senior Manager for clients that can't staff the role themselves
* Partner with our SOC and OT security engineers so our managed services produce complete, audit-ready evidence
* Hire, lead, and develop a team of CIP compliance consultants
* Be the NERC CIP expert behind our sales and marketing team: scope engagements, shape proposals, and build trusted relationships with client compliance and executive leaders
* Develop and deliver NERC CIP training for client personnel, contractors, and vendors
* Track NERC, FERC, and Regional Entity developments and turn them into client guidance and new offerings

**What You Need for this Position**

* 10+ years of NERC CIP compliance experience, including 5+ years in a lead or management role
* A track record of building CIP compliance programs from the ground up and running them over time
* Direct experience leading or representing registered entities through Regional Entity audits, with successful outcomes
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of the NERC CIP Reliability Standards (CIP-002 through CIP-015) and how Regional Entities audit them, including RSAWs
* Command of NERC registration, functional registrations, CFRs, the ERO Portal, and related regional tools
* Experience writing CIP policies, procedures, plans, and internal controls that hold up under audit, and designing the evidence processes behind them
* Experience with enforcement, including self-reports and mitigation plans
* Experience with High, Medium, and/or Low impact BES Cyber Systems
* Working knowledge of OT environments (SCADA, substations, generation and renewable plant controls) to translate technical controls into compliance evidence
* Background as a utility or generator CIP Senior Manager or compliance lead, a Regional Entity CIP auditor, or a senior consultant in a NERC CIP practice
* The ability to lead people, set standards, and grow a team
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the credibility to be a client's trusted advisor
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, CIS, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent NERC CIP compliance experience
* Ability to travel to client sites and audits

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience running low impact CIP-003 programs for solar, wind, or battery storage
* GCIP, GICSP, CISSP, or CISA certification
* Experience building or leading a consulting or compliance services team
* Experience scoping CIP engagements and supporting sales as the technical expert

**Why This Role Matters**

The NERC CIP Program Director is the key person behind a brand new service line at Vertech. You will define what we offer, how we deliver it, and who delivers it, and the programs you build will carry our energy clients through their audits for years. No pressure. But we think that makes it one of the most interesting CIP roles out there.

Title: CUI-OPERATIONS MANAGER
Description:
**Operations Manager**
======================

**Position Overview**
---------------------

CUI Cable Services is seeking an experienced and results-driven **Operations Manager.**

This position plays a critical role in leading day-to-day field operations, developing high-performing installation teams, and ensuring residential fiber installations are completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in telecommunications, fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) installations, and field service operations. This individual will be responsible for managing field supervisors and installation technicians, driving operational performance, maintaining workforce accountability, and ensuring our operations consistently meet or exceed Google Fiber's performance expectations.

We are looking for someone who understands the demands of a fast-paced telecommunications environment and can balance technician development, customer experience, productivity, and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Field Operations & Performance Management**

* Oversee daily residential fiber installation operations throughout the Nashville market, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and according to established standards.
* Manage and support field supervisors and residential installation technicians to achieve operational goals and performance expectations.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including installation completion rates, technician productivity, quality assurance, repeat service visits, customer satisfaction, and on-time performance.
* Identify operational challenges, implement corrective action plans, and continuously improve field performance.
* Coordinate daily workforce allocation, technician scheduling, and installation capacity to meet customer demand and service commitments.
* Ensure all installations comply with Google Fiber specifications, company procedures, and applicable industry standards.
* Analyze operational reports and performance trends to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and service delivery.

### **Leadership & Technician Development**

* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and accountability to field supervisors and residential installation technicians.
* Oversee new technician onboarding, field training, and readiness to ensure employees are prepared to perform installations independently.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular evaluations, coaching sessions, and corrective action discussions.
* Develop a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and professional development.

### **Installation Quality & Customer Experience**

* Ensure residential fiber installations meet established technical specifications, quality requirements, and customer service standards.
* Monitor installation quality through field inspections, quality audits, and performance reviews.
* Reduce repeat service visits, installation defects, and customer escalations through proactive coaching and process improvements.
* Work closely with field supervisors to resolve complex installation challenges and customer service concerns.
* Reinforce professional customer interactions, proper installation practices, and respect for customer property.

### **Safety, Compliance & Operational Standards**

* Promote and enforce a safety-first culture across all field operations.
* Ensure technicians follow company safety policies, OSHA requirements, ladder safety procedures, and applicable telecommunications installation standards.
* Maintain accountability for company-issued vehicles, tools, equipment, and other operational assets.
* Ensure technicians maintain required credentials, training, and qualifications.
* Investigate safety incidents, equipment damage, and operational concerns while implementing appropriate corrective measures.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in telecommunications, broadband, fiber installation, or related field service operations.
* At least 3 years of leadership experience managing field technicians, supervisors, or operational teams.
* Strong understanding of residential fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) installations, including installation procedures, troubleshooting, and service quality standards.
* Demonstrated ability to manage operational performance through measurable KPIs and performance reporting.
* Experience managing technician productivity, installation quality, workforce scheduling, and customer satisfaction.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple operational priorities in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Previous operational leadership experience supporting Google Fiber or another major telecommunications provider.
* Experience managing residential fiber installation teams in a high-volume production environment.
* Familiarity with fiber optic installation practices, optical network terminals (ONTs), customer premises equipment, and fiber troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated success improving operational efficiency, reducing repeat service visits, and increasing technician productivity.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

The successful Operations Manager will demonstrate the ability to:

* **Build and retain strong teams:** Develop a reliable, engaged workforce of residential installation technicians and field supervisors.
* **Drive operational excellence:** Consistently achieve installation productivity, quality, and service performance targets.
* **Deliver exceptional customer experiences:** Minimize customer escalations, repeat visits, and installation-related complaints.
* **Lead through accountability:** Establish clear expectations, provide meaningful coaching, and address performance concerns.
* **Strengthen client relationships:** Maintain consistent communication and deliver reliable results that support Google Fiber's operational objectives.
* **Improve business performance:** Optimize labor utilization, manage operational costs, and identify opportunities for sustainable growth.

**Work Environment & Expectations**
-----------------------------------

This position requires a combination of office-based management and active field leadership. The Operations Manager must be comfortable visiting installation sites, conducting field observations, supporting technicians, and responding to operational challenges as they arise.

Flexibility to work outside standard business hours may be necessary to support installation schedules, customer needs, and operational priorities.

**Why Join CUI Cable Services?**
--------------------------------

At CUI Cable Services, our success starts with the people who keep our communities connected.

We provide essential telecommunications services and believe strong leadership, quality workmanship, and exceptional customer experiences are the foundation of a successful operation.

As an Operations Manager supporting our Google Fiber operations in Nashville, you will have the opportunity to lead a growing field organization, develop talented technicians, improve operational performance, and make a measurable impact on the business.

**If you are a telecommunications leader who thrives on building teams, driving results, and delivering operational excellence, we encourage you to apply.**

*CUI Cable Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws.*

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites to deliver fast, low-latency broadband to unserved and underserved communities worldwide. Getting those satellites to orbit depends on secure operations at partner-operated launch, test and processing facilities around the world.  
  
Amazon Corporate Security (ACS) is hiring a Non-Traditional Environments (NTE) Security Manager to lead physical security delivery for Amazon Leo’s operations at third-party and non-traditional Leo locations in the US and abroad. These include test labs, payload processing facilities, secure storage sites and temporary operating locations where Amazon must work within host organization constraints to deliver security. We're looking for a leader who lives Amazon's Leadership Principles, especially Customer Obsession, Ownership, Earn Trust and Bias for Action.  
  
Reporting to the Amazon Leo Physical Security Sr. Manager, you'll own the delivery of ACS security services at sites that Amazon doesn't control. Your services protect Leo people, satellites, hardware, infrastructure, and intellectual property (IP) through influence, partnership and well-run vendor management. You'll work closely with the facility operator, the launch provider, local authorities and guard vendors. Inside Amazon, you'll work with Leo IP and Infrastructure Security, Trade & Compliance, Legal, Logistics and Leo mission teams. The environment is ambiguous and changes fast. Schedules move, requirements change, and you'll often be the most senior Amazon security leader on site.  
  
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be U.S. citizens to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Deliver best-in-class security services to meet business and security partner defined outcomes, focused on enhancing the safety and security of all Amazon employees, contractors, and visitors
* Manage day-to-day security operations for a diverse portfolio of locations and customers with unique requirements in an ambiguous environment
* Proactively audit and identify security gaps at Amazon Leo locations while managing audit action items to close, working under tight duration guidelines
* Be the trusted security advisor and subject matter expert for all levels of Amazon and Amazon Leo employees in the assigned area of responsibility, through high-quality communication and excellent briefing skills
* Implement and improve security plans, security systems, guarding operations, policies, and programs
* Travel within the US and internationally for up to 45 days at a time to manage security delivery and build local partnerships
* Coordinate physical security incident response and reporting
* Respond to customer security concerns
* Earn trust through key customer and stakeholder engagements, and liaison with external partners
* Work cross functionally with Intellectual Property and Infrastructure Security, Legal, Trade & Compliance, EHS, and Leo business teams to establish scalable physical security standards that meet the businesses’ needs

A day in the life  

* Oversee guarding operations and hold guarding vendors accountable for quality and frugality
* Build relationships with internal and external security and Amazon Leo partners
* Develop and monitor performance metrics to track and improve performance. Implement measurable processes to improve performance and communicate outcomes

* Plan and lead security readiness activities across sites
* Manage cross-functional projects and operations. Drive team(s)/partners to meet program and/or product goals
* Conduct initial incident investigations and collaborate with specialist security teams to support the customer

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Description:

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Fueling for Data Center**
================================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager leads Cat5’s preventive maintenance and fueling program for a national wireless infrastructure client, with a fleet made up mostly of portable generators. The role coordinates scheduled maintenance, routine and emergency fuel deliveries, portable unit deployment and recovery, field personnel and vendors, safety, client communications, and complete service and fuel-delivery documentation.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Mostly on-site in North Texas, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, on-time fueling, emergency response, fuel-delivery accuracy and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Review maintenance findings, identify deficiencies and coordinate escalation of repair needs to the appropriate repair team for client approval.
* Plan recurring generator fueling, fuel-level checks and emergency refueling based on client requirements, site access and generator operating needs.
* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.
* Enforce quality standards through maintenance checklists, fuel-delivery tickets, meter readings, photographs and complete site-level work-order records.
* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.
* Ensure preventive maintenance and fueling activities follow applicable safety, spill-prevention, environmental and fuel-handling requirements.
* Ensure technicians record generator condition, alarms, fluid levels, battery checks, fuel levels and test results during service visits.
* Obtain required client approvals for nonroutine fueling, emergency deliveries and out-of-scope maintenance before proceeding.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.
* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.
* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.
* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.
* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.
* Coordinate approved fuel suppliers and maintenance-material vendors, including delivery coverage and service expectations.
* Record maintenance materials, delivered fuel quantities, delivery confirmations and associated costs in designated systems.
* Use maintenance schedules, historical fuel usage and generator run time to plan service materials and fueling requirements.
* Review fuel-supply capacity, delivery lead times and critical maintenance materials with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, fuel tickets, invoices and vendor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes, fueling dispatches and portable generator deployments based on geography, site priority and personnel qualifications.
* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up maintenance visits, missed fuel deliveries and client communication for incomplete work.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site preventive maintenance schedules, fueling routes, dispatch priorities and travel logistics.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.
* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.
* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.
* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, fueling requirements and service scopes.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in North Texas, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to fuel vendors, maintenance partners and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for emergency fueling, portable generator deployment, generator outages and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion, fueling delivery and work-order closeout.
* Fueling dispatch, emergency delivery and maintenance response within contract requirements.
* Every maintenance visit and fuel delivery documented with required readings, quantities and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator readiness, fewer low-fuel incidents and timely resolution of maintenance deficiencies.
* Accurate fuel reconciliation, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

  
  
  

**Job Description**

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

  
  
  

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

  
  
  

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

  
  
  

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

  
  
  

**What Fiix Business Systems Does**

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

  
  
  

**Your Responsibilities**

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

* Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
* Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
* Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
* Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
* Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
* Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.
  

  
  

Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
* Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
* Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
* Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.
  

  
  

Leadership & Team Development

* Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.
  

  
  

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
* Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
* Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
* As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
* Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
* Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
* Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
* Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.
* Build strong working relationships with enterprise transformation, IT, Finance and portfolio product leaders to deliver coordinated outcomes.
  

  
  

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
* Legal authorization to work in Canada or the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
* Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25% of the time.
* Typically requires 8 years of management experience.
  

  
  

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Proven track record of stabilizing and scaling business systems or revenue operations in a high-demand environment with a significant backlog.
* Experience owning a roadmap for Salesforce-based go-to-market and quote-to-cash systems.
* Experience leading business systems transformation, operating model design or platform modernization (e.g., CRM/quote-to-cash modernization or post-acquisition operating model design).
* Experience in a SaaS or subscription software business, including CPQ, subscription billing, renewals and revenue recognition processes.
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and CPQ, and connected tools (e.g., NetSuite, Boomi, Gainsight, Marketo, LeanData, Zendesk).
* Experience leading organizational change, restructuring teams or scaling operations.
* Experience working in a product management / PMO / engineering operating model and with agile delivery.
* You can explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.
* Familiarity with industrial software, asset management or maintenance (CMMS) markets.
* Experience defining the operating model for a SaaS business within a larger, multi-business enterprise.
* Experience working with large, multi-year enterprise transformation programs and global IT organizations.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud / revenue management, and commerce platforms.
  

  
  

### **What We Offer:**

* Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
* 401k
* Paid Time off
* Parental and Caregiver Leave
* Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
* To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www. raquickfind.com .
  

  
  

For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $140,400 - $210,600 CAD with an annual target bonus of 10% of base salary.

  
  
  

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

Title: IT Operations Manager
Description:
**Job Description**

The Texas General Land Office is seeking a Manager VII (IT Operations Manager) within the Information Technology Services Department of the agency.

Performs highly advanced managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of the Information Technology Services (ITS) Cloud Operations function. The Cloud Operations Manager leads staff responsible for the agency's cloud, infrastructure, and technology operations and ensures services support GLO programs reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Work involves establishing goals, priorities, guidelines, procedures, and service standards; directing staff performance and development; coordinating daily operations and modernization initiatives; evaluating service performance and operational risk; developing and monitoring budget requests and expenditures; and recommending improvements. The position coordinates with ITS teams, security and governance partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to align services and resources with agency needs.

**Our Mission:**

The Texas General Land Office primarily serves the schoolchildren, veterans, and the environment of Texas. The agency does so by preserving our history, maximizing state revenue through innovative administration, and through the prudent stewardship of state lands and natural resources.

**What Your Contributions to the GLO Will be:**

* People Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervises and supports individual contributors by setting expectations, assigning and prioritizing work, monitoring performance, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional development. Builds a cohesive, accountable team environment; addresses performance issues; and ensures staff have the skills, tools, and resources needed to meet operational objectives.
* Operational Execution & Team Delivery: Executes established strategies and plans by coordinating day-to-day team activities, managing priorities and schedules, tracking progress against goals, and resolving operational issues. Ensures work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with agency policies, standards, and service expectations.
* Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization: Leads planning and modernization of the agency's cloud and infrastructure environments. Sets priorities for cloud readiness, migration, platform lifecycle, capacity, and technical debt reduction. Coordinates with technology teams and business stakeholders to align work with agency needs.
* Infrastructure Reliability, Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Oversees the reliability and availability of infrastructure services, including continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Directs work to improve backup, recovery, monitoring, capacity, and service resilience, and tracks recovery objectives for critical systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance: Coordinates with security and governance partners to reduce operational risk and support compliance. Oversees implementation of approved controls for access management, secure configuration, network protection, logging, vulnerability remediation, and audit response across infrastructure services.
* Budget, Procurement & Vendor Oversight: Monitors budgets, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance for CloudOps services. Evaluates resource needs and technology options, monitors expenditures, and recommends investments that support agency priorities and operational efficiency.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business administration, or a related field; relevant education and experience may be considered in combination.
* At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, systems administration, or a closely related field.
* At least three (3) years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and supporting staff development.
* Experience coordinating technology operations or modernization work across teams, assessing service risks, and communicating status and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting infrastructure reliability, security controls, service continuity, or disaster recovery in an enterprise environment.

**Location Requirement:**
This position is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must be currently located in the Austin area or willing to relocate at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not provided.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, cloud or infrastructure services, or technology service delivery, including several years in a management role.
* Experience in a state agency, public-sector, or similarly regulated environment, including familiarity with security, audit, procurement, and records requirements.
* Experience with cloud adoption and migration, hybrid infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise networking, backup and recovery, and monitoring or observability.
* Experience managing operating budgets, service contracts, vendors, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident response, and service performance measures.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires the employee to primarily perform sedentary office work; however, mobility (moving around the worksite) is routinely required to carry out some duties. This position requires extensive computer, telephone and client/ customer contact and communication. It requires the ability to move and position oneself as needed for filing and similar routine office duties. The job also requires normal cognitive abilities requiring the ability to learn, recall, and apply certain practices and policies. It requires the stamina to maintain attention to detail despite interruptions. Ability to read printed materials and computer screens. The individual must be able to move and transport records, documents, boxes, and all related information and materials, weighing up to 20 pounds when required.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Free Parking
* Defined Retirement Benefit Plan Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts
* Medical Insurance - State pays 100% of the health plan premium for eligible full-time employees and 50% of the premium for their eligible dependents. The State pays 50% of the eligible part-time employees' premium and 25% for eligible dependents.
* Optional Benefits such as dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Minimum of 96+ Hours of Annual Leave a year \*\*Annual leave increases with length of service.
* Professional Development Opportunities: The GLO offers numerous courses to help our employees grow using resources through LinkedIn Learning and our EAP provider.

**Veterans:**

Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser:

Military Crosswalk for Occupational Category - Information Technology

* Applications must be fully completed and include a comprehensive employment history, detailing job titles, dates of employment, employer names, supervisors' names and phone numbers, and a summary of responsibilities. Submission of a résumé is also required.
* In accordance with federal law, all individuals selected for hire will be required to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the appropriate employment eligibility verification documentation upon hire.
* Positions assigned to this classification are designated as security-sensitive pursuant to Texas Labor Code, Section 301.042.

Title: Program Manager - Hardware/NPI
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Eagle Wireless is seeking a Program Manager to own and drive customer programs through a phase-gate hardware development process — from initial engagement and design through EVT, DVT, PVT, qualification, certification, and ramp to mass production. This role requires hands-on experience managing an engineered hardware product (e.g., a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device) through phase-gate NPI to manufacturing release, and comfort coordinating across engineering, supply chain, quality, and external manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage customer-facing programs end-to-end: requirements intake, design and engineering coordination, qualification/testing, certification, and transition to volume manufacturing.
* Own program timelines and deliverables, tracking milestones through phase-gate NPI stages (e.g., EVT, DVT, PVT) to mass production, and flagging/resolving risks before they impact schedule.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts, managing expectations and communicating status, risks, and changes clearly and proactively.
* Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing (including contract manufacturing partners) to ensure readiness at each program gate.
* Lead and support phase-gate reviews across the NPI process — including PRD sign-off, design reviews (PDR/CDR), DFM/DFT review, pilot build coordination, and manufacturing readiness assessments.
* Manage BOM, ECO, and documentation control processes in coordination with engineering and supply chain teams.
* Track and help drive regulatory and carrier certification requirements (e.g., FCC, PTCRB, carrier certification) to support program milestones.
* Support manufacturing transfer and cutover activities, including coordination between design/engineering sites and manufacturing partners.
* Prepare and present program status reports, timelines, and risk assessments to internal leadership and customers.
* Identify and drive process improvements within the PMO to improve program predictability and delivery.

**Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in program or project management, including 2+ years specifically managing hardware products through phase-gate NPI (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience managing an engineered hardware product — such as a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device — through a phase-gate development cycle to manufacturing release, from concept/design through qualification and into volume production.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers or external manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of phase-gate/stage-gate NPI processes (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent), BOM/ECO management, DFx (DFM/DFT/DFA), and manufacturing readiness gates.

Description:

**Description**
****About the Role****
The Technical Lead owns end-to-end delivery across the organization's modern and legacy enterprise technology stacks. The role is accountable for functional delivery and equally for non-functional requirements (NFRs): performance, scalability, availability, observability, security and maintainability. You will keep business-critical systems stable and secure, lead their evolution to modern architecture, and ensure every solution aligns with enterprise architecture standards set by the Technology Architecture Group (TAG).
  
  
**Your Duties Would Include**
**Technical leadership**

* Define architecture, standards and patterns for front end, back end, data and integrations across both stacks.
* Lead the modernization roadmap, such as legacy web frameworks to modern SPA frameworks, .NET Framework to modern .NET, and monolith to microservices. Use incremental approaches and plan for coexistence.
* Make build, buy, refactor or retire decisions, and track technical debt.
* Run design reviews, spikes and proofs of concept. Turn requirements into architecture plans, estimates and task breakdowns.

**Non-functional Requirements (NFR) Ownership**

* Elicit, define, prioritize and document NFRs with stakeholders at the start of every initiative: performance, scalability, availability/SLA, resilience, capacity, security, observability, supportability and compliance.
* Convert NFRs into measurable targets (SLOs, response-time and throughput thresholds) and acceptance criteria, and design for them from the start.
* Verify NFRs before release through load, stress, soak and resilience testing, and sign off against agreed targets.
* Own capacity planning, caching, query and API optimization, and bottleneck analysis.
* Track NFR debt and include it in backlog prioritization.

**Observability and performance engineering**

* Implement and govern monitoring, logging, tracing and APM using enterprise tooling (ELK stack, Dynatrace, Azure Application Insights).
* Define standard logging, correlation ID, health-check, alerting and dashboard practices across services.
* Perform proactive performance analysis, production incident triage and root-cause analysis using APM data.
* Plan and run load and performance testing (for example JMeter, k6, Azure Load Testing, or equivalent) and report results with recommendations.

**DevSecOps and security**

* Embed security into the pipeline: static analysis (SonarQube), software composition and dependency scanning (Nexus IQ / Sonatype), and GitHub Advanced Security (code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot).
* Own the remediation lifecycle for findings, with prioritization, ownership and SLA-based closure. Prevent quality-gate bypass.
* Coordinate with IT Security on VAPT (vulnerability assessment and penetration testing): scope, environment readiness, fix and retest, and closure evidence.
* Apply OWASP, secure coding, secrets management and hardening practices. Apply OAuth2/OIDC, JWT and role-based access, including bridging legacy authentication to modern identity.
* Keep dependencies, packages and runtime versions current, and retire unsupported components.

**Enterprise architecture alignment**

* Align solution designs with TAG principles, reference architectures, approved technology standards and governance checkpoints.
* Prepare and present design documentation for architecture review, and secure approvals and exceptions where deviations are needed.
* Ensure reuse of shared frameworks, libraries and patterns, and avoid technology sprawl.
* Contribute to the enterprise technology roadmap and standards.

**Hands-on delivery**

* Write and review production code on both stacks, and debug complex issues in legacy code with limited tests or documentation.
* Own API contracts, database changes and integrations (REST, SOAP, messaging, batch and file interfaces).
* Drive CI/CD, release management and environment strategy for on-premises (IIS, Windows services) and containerized deployments.

**Team and stakeholders**

* Mentor engineers, including upskilling legacy-focused developers on modern technologies.
* Partner with Product, BA, QA, Architecture, Security, DBA, Infrastructure and vendor teams.
* Act as the escalation point for production incidents.

**Required Skills**
**Modern stack**

* Front end - Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, state management), Ionic/Capacitor, SCSS, responsive and accessible UI
* Back end - .NET 6/8+, ASP.NET Core Web API, microservices, worker services, WebSockets/gRPC, API gateway
* Data - SQL Server (stored procedures, indexing, tuning), Redis, EF Core/Dapper
* Messaging/integration - RabbitMQ or similar brokers, event-driven design, REST
* DevOps/hosting - CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift
* Security - OAuth2/OIDC, Keycloak or similar IdP, JWT, OWASP

**Legacy stack**

* Front end - AngularJS 1.x, jQuery, Kendo UI, Bootstrap, Razor/MVC views, ES5 JavaScript
* Back end - .NET Framework 4.x, ASP.NET MVC / Web API 2, WCF/SOAP, Windows services, EF6 / ADO.NET
* Data - Legacy schemas, SSRS, SSIS/ETL, data warehouse jobs
* Messaging/integration - Enterprise MQ, file/batch interfaces, SOAP
* DevOps/hosting - IIS, Windows Server, MSBuild, older pipelines
* Security - Forms/Windows auth, legacy session handling, remediation of aging libraries

**NFR, Observability And Security Tooling (required)**

* Observability/APM: ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Dynatrace, Azure Application Insights.
* Performance testing: load, stress and soak testing tools, results analysis and tuning.
* DevSecOps: SonarQube, Nexus IQ / Sonatype, GitHub Advanced Security, secrets management.

Title: Senior Manager, JSOC & Threat Hunting
Description:
Questrade is on a mission to help Canadians to become much more financially successful and secure.
