Title: Recreational Services Task Leader/CAC Program Manager
Location: Al Khor and Al Thakhira, Qatar
Description:
**Purpose and Scope:**
The Recreational Services Task Leader/Marketing Manager (TLMM) is a key leadership position responsible for executing and overseeing all recreational programs and services that fall under the recreational portion of the Installation Support Services (ISS) contract at Al Udeid Air Base (AUAB), Qatar. This role provides daily management, supervision, scheduling, and quality control across all recreational service areas, including Fitness Centers, Lounge Operations, Community Activity Center (CAC), Learning Resource Center (LRC), Theater Operations, Pool/Lifeguard Services, and special events.
  
  
The Marketing Manager portion of the position also serves as the central coordinator for all marketing-related functions supporting EFSS activities—responsible for event calendars, advertising materials, cross‑marketing, customer engagement, and promotion of morale, welfare, and recreation (MWR) programs across AUAB. The TLMM acts with full authority for all recreational service activities and ensures compliance with PWS standards, customer satisfaction thresholds, reporting timelines, and safety and force protection requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the Task Leader responsible for all requirements outlined in the following functional areas: fitness center operations, lounge operations, community activities centers, learning resource center (LRC), theaters, and pool lifeguard services.
* Must exercise full authority for daily operations, personnel scheduling, supervision, and quality control.
* Must acknowledge discrepancies and valid complaints within 24 hours and shall achieve resolution within 48 hours. The TLMM shall be available within 2 hours to meet on the installation with Government personnel (designated by the ACO) to discuss focus areas.
* Ensure 24/7/365 service coverage at all required recreational customer service desks (LRC, CAC, Fitness Centers).
* Oversee Fitness Center operations, ensuring compliance with DAFI 34‑114, local guidance, safety regulations, cleaning standards, equipment readiness, and minimum program delivery thresholds.
* Oversee Lounge Operations, including alcohol service compliance, ration control, cash handling, inventory management, POS system operations, staffing, entertainment support, and customer service performance standards.
* Manage Community Activity Center programs including weekly events, tournaments, games, special entertainment, and ensuring required minimum offerings and performance metrics.
* Oversee Theater program operations, scheduling, AV support, cleaning standards, movie/event coordination, and guest engagement.
* Oversee Pool Operations and Lifeguard Services, ensuring compliance with safety, sanitation, chemical monitoring, staffing rotation, logs, and activity programming.
* Ensure readiness and cleanliness standards for all recreational areas, equipment, restrooms, locker rooms, pool decks, and common customer spaces.
* Develop, coordinate, and publish 90‑day lookahead calendars and monthly event calendars for fitness, pool, lounge, CAC, and theater activities in accordance with PWS requirements.
* Coordinate advertising materials, marketing flyers, talking papers, registration sheets, and promotional content with EFSS Marketing.
* Ensure all events are properly cross‑marketed across AUAB distribution channels to maximize participation.
* Lead customer engagement strategies, including QR-code feedback systems, surveys, After‑Action Reports, and customer communication.
* Prepare and submit After‑Action Reports within 48 hours for all events, activities, tournaments, and special entertainment programs.
* Supervise a diverse workforce of USNs, LNs, and OCNs, ensuring training, certifications, scheduling, and compliance with escort policies.
* Ensure personnel qualifications such as CPR, First Aid, AED, lifeguard certifications, and fitness instructor qualifications are always current.
* Maintain staffing plans that meet PWS requirements for each sub‑function, including minimum instructor‑led classes, personal training sessions, lounge cashier requirements, and lifeguard coverage.
* Ensure all customer service desks meet complaint thresholds and service standards as outlined in the PWS.
* Enforce professional standards, performance expectations, uniform/appearance guidelines, and safety requirements.
* Maintain compliance with all PWS service thresholds (e.g., equipment availability, event minimums, customer complaint limits, cleanliness requirements).
* Lead internal quality control inspections, develop corrective actions, and ensure trends are identified and mitigated.
* Prepare and deliver required deliverable reports as required by the contract.
* Ensure compliance with Host Nation Regulations, Base access procedures, LN/OCN escort policies, and safety and environmental protocols.
* Oversee proper stewardship and accountability of all recreational equipment, furniture, electronics, and supplies.
* Manage equipment life cycle planning, including 5‑year replacement forecasts and proactive ordering according to PWS timelines.
* Coordinate maintenance and service requests with the Fitness Maintenance Team and lodging/CE channels.
* Maintain inventories for resale items, prizes, consumables, recreation gear, and resource protection documentation per NAF and AF standards.

**Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, hospitality, recreation management, or related field.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in managing recreation, hospitality, MWR, or similar programs.
* Minimum 3 years of proven leadership experience.
* Experience leading teams in high‑tempo, customer‑facing service environments.
* Possess a valid US driver's license and US passport.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain Secret Clearance.
* Demonstrated experience supervising diverse teams and managing service contract operations.
* Ability to create and coordinate marketing materials, calendars, promotional campaigns, and customer engagement tools.
* Experience providing excellent customer service in supporting contract responsibilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment handling multiple tasks at a given time and rapidly adapting to changing priorities and schedules and under pressure of deadlines while maintaining performance standards.
* Strong ability to lead a team of diverse and dynamic employees. Outstanding problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
* Experience with working and communicating with the Government or military personnel.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to make rapid, informed decisions.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications and ability to interpret and manage technical data, schedules, reports, and personnel documentation.

**Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:**

* Availability to work extended hours, 6-day workweeks, and support 24/7 operations as mission requires.
* Proven experience managing fitness centers, lounges, pools, or recreational programs in military or expeditionary settings.
* Knowledge of Air Force Services (FSS/EFSS) operations and NAF processes.
* Experience in event production, large‑scale recreational programming, or hospitality marketing.
* Exposure to desert climate, prolonged standing, and facility walkthroughs.
* Must operate in a deployed, austere environment with high operational tempo.
* Ability to successfully pass contract medical requirements and maintain requirements for duration of deployment.

As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks, and serving on safety committees and teams.

Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.

Title: Head of Enterprise Architecture
Description:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

The Head of Enterprise Architecture (HEA) is responsible for establishing and leading Medica's enterprise architecture organization and ensuring Medica’s enterprise architecture aligns and enables, our business strategy, operating capabilities, technology, data, and processes, resulting in measurable and increasing enterprise value. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, the HEA serves as a strategic advisor to the CIO and senior business and technology leaders and leads a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines. The HEA also leads an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice to align architects and architecture-adjacent roles around common principles, standards, methods, patterns, and decision practices.

Business Architecture is a foundational discipline of the practice. The HEA ensures a clear understanding of enterprise business objectives, the current and required state of business capabilities, and the value-aligned roadmaps needed to move from current to target state. These roadmaps integrate changes across technology, data, processes, organization, skills, and operating models. The role partners closely with the Office of the CIO, Enterprise Transformation, Business Process Re-engineering, Product Ownership, Engineering, Data, Security, and business leadership to translate strategy into executable change.

The HEA will evolve Enterprise Architecture from a traditional, centralized governance model toward an enabling, embedded, and delivery-oriented practice. Architecture will engage earlier and more deeply in strategic and day-to-day delivery, using reusable standards, reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and risk-based decision frameworks to accelerate sound decisions. The HEA will also advance AI-enabled architecture practices to automate routine documentation, analysis, standards validation, knowledge management, and governance activities so architects can focus on solving critical business problems, transformation, complex design decisions, and delivery enablement.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Structure and Advance Enterprise Architecture Practices**

* Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture strategy, operating model, principles, standards, methods, and practices.
* Establish Business Architecture as the connective layer between enterprise strategy, transformation, product portfolios, business processes, organizational design, data, and technology.
* Ensure development and maintenance of enterprise business capability models; partner to assess current-state maturity and identify capability gaps, dependencies, duplication, and investment needs.
* Translate enterprise strategy and business objectives into target states, transition states, and value-aligned capability roadmaps integrating changes to people, process, technology, data, organization, skills, and operating models.
* Provide enterprise leaders with clear views of strategic dependencies, tradeoffs, sequencing, technical health, and investment implications.
* Ensure technology strategy is traceable to business strategy and capability requirements.

**Deliver Enterprise Transformation & Strategy through Architecture**

* Serve as a strategic architecture advisor to the CIO, executive leadership, Transformation, Product, and business leaders.
* Partner with Enterprise Transformation and Business Process Re-engineering to connect strategic objectives, transformation portfolios, and process redesign to required business-capability changes.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to connect enterprise capability roadmaps with product strategies, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure architecture strategy reflects the operating, regulatory, data, and interoperability requirements of a healthcare organization, with particular emphasis on the health plan/payer environment.
* Provide architectural leadership for healthcare interoperability and industry standards, including X12 EDI, HL7 FHIR, USCDI, and other applicable healthcare information-exchange standards.
* Translate regulatory and interoperability requirements into enterprise capabilities and strategic roadmaps in partnership with Compliance, Legal, Security, Privacy, Product, Data, and business leaders.

**Architecture Enablement & Governance**

* Modernize the Architecture Review process from a primarily centralized approval mechanism into a risk-based architecture enablement model embedded earlier in strategy, discovery, design, and delivery.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, standards, guardrails, decision frameworks, and architecture decision records that increase delivery autonomy while maintaining enterprise alignment.
* Define clear decision rights across Enterprise Architecture, domain architecture, solution architecture, Engineering, Product, Security, Data, and related functions.
* Partner with engineering and technology leaders to evaluate and select strategic platforms, core technologies, architectural patterns, and engineering approaches.
* Guide modernization of core capabilities including Cloud, APIs, integration, data platforms, automation, AI, SaaS, and digital capabilities while reducing unnecessary complexity, duplication, and technical debt.
* Use AI and automation to improve architecture knowledge discovery, documentation, standards validation, impact analysis, dependency identification, and governance workflows, freeing architects for higher-value work.
* Measure architecture effectiveness through business outcomes, delivery enablement, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, technology health, and decision quality.

**Architecture Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines.
* Establish and lead an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice encompassing architects and architecture-adjacent roles across centralized and distributed teams.
* Define common architecture principles, terminology, methods, artifacts, modeling approaches, standards, and expectations across the organization.
* Create mechanisms for knowledge sharing, reusable solutions, emerging practices, and lessons learned across the architecture community.
* Develop architecture talent, competency models, career paths, succession plans, and leadership capability across the enterprise.
* Build an architecture culture based on influence, transparency, collaboration, practical guidance, and accountability rather than centralized control.
* Operate effectively from executive strategy through delivery-level architecture, communicating complex business and technology concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 15+ years of progressively responsible experience across enterprise technology, architecture, business transformation, engineering, or related disciplines; significant leadership experience building and leading enterprise or domain architecture functions in complex organizations.
* 5+ years of people management experience leading highly technical roles in direct, indirect, and contractor roles.
* Business capability modeling and capability-based planning; strategy-to-execution alignment; value-stream and operating-model analysis; enterprise transformation and roadmap development; architecture governance and operating models; modern cloud, API, integration, data, security, SaaS, automation, and AI architectures; healthcare interoperability; executive communication, facilitation, organizational change, stakeholder influence, and talent development

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience managing vendor relationships.
* Healthcare payer / managed care experience strongly preferred; broader healthcare experience considered.

Title: AIR FREIGHT PRICING AND OPERATIONS MANAGER
Description:
Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager

**Company:** Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Department:** Air Freight Operations & Pricing  
**Position Level:** Senior Management  
**Reports To:** Directors & Management

Job Overview

Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC is seeking a **highly experienced, commercially driven, and result-oriented Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager** to take complete ownership of the company's air freight operations, pricing, airline relationships, and business development opportunities.

We are looking for a strong leader with extensive knowledge of international air freight, transshipment operations, airline pricing, and CMC (Cargo Mega Terminal) facilities and their potential business opportunities.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently managing the entire operations and pricing team, maintaining strong airline relationships, maximizing enquiry conversions, ensuring operational excellence, and taking full accountability for departmental performance.

**This is an ownership-driven leadership position, not merely an operational supervisory role.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Complete Operations Management & Accountability**

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day performance of the Air Freight Operations and Pricing Department.
* Lead, supervise, train, and guide the entire operations and pricing team.
* Ensure every customer enquiry is properly reviewed, priced, followed up, and converted wherever commercially feasible.
* Take complete accountability for all enquiries, quotations, bookings, shipment execution, and operational escalations.
* Establish clear responsibilities, productivity standards, and performance expectations for each team member.
* Ensure timely shipment execution, accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with all stakeholders.
* Independently resolve operational challenges and implement preventive measures.

**2. Airline Relationships & Pricing Management**

* Maintain excellent working relationships with major airlines, GSAs, cargo terminals, and handling agents.
* Negotiate competitive freight rates, special rates, allotments, and commercial arrangements.
* Possess strong knowledge of airline networks, routing options, capacity availability, and international cargo regulations.
* Develop effective pricing strategies to improve both conversion rates and gross profitability.
* Build direct relationships with airline decision-makers to secure commercially advantageous opportunities.
* Continuously monitor market rates, competitor pricing, and airline developments.

**3. Transshipment & CMC Business Development**

* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of international cargo transshipment operations through Dubai and other major hubs.
* Identify and develop business opportunities involving CMC facilities, cargo consolidation, transit cargo, and cross-border freight movements.
* Develop commercially viable solutions for cargo movements through Dubai, including documentation, handling, routing, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish relationships with international freight forwarding agents and overseas business partners.
* Identify new trade lanes, airline partnerships, and transshipment business opportunities.
* Present practical business development proposals to management, including revenue potential, expected margins, operational requirements, and implementation plans.

**4. Enquiry Management & 95% Conversion Target**

* Drive the department toward a **target of 95% conversion of qualified, commercially viable enquiries**.
* Ensure 100% of enquiries are recorded, assigned, monitored, and followed up.
* Implement a structured quotation and follow-up system to minimize lost business.
* Analyze unsuccessful quotations and identify the reasons for lost business.
* Ensure quotations are competitive, accurate, profitable, and delivered within established turnaround times.
* Work closely with the Sales Department to convert enquiries into confirmed shipments.
* Take ownership of improving enquiry quality, quotation efficiency, customer retention, and shipment volumes.

**5. Weekly Management Reporting**

Submit a detailed weekly performance report to management covering:

* Total enquiries received, quotations submitted, and shipments confirmed.
* Enquiry conversion percentage and comparison against the 95% target.
* Total sales revenue and gross profit generated.
* Shipment volumes, chargeable weight, and major trade lanes.
* Lost enquiries, reasons for non-conversion, and corrective actions.
* Airline rate developments and negotiated commercial benefits.
* Individual team performance, productivity, and accountability.
* Operational issues, shipment delays, and resolutions.
* New business opportunities, particularly in transshipment and CMC operations.
* Action plan for the coming week with measurable targets.

The Manager must be able to **explain departmental performance, identify shortcomings, and present actionable solutions rather than merely report figures.**

**6. Leadership & Professional Representation**

* Represent the company professionally in meetings with airlines, customers, international agents, and business partners.
* Maintain excellent personal presentation, professional grooming, communication, and business etiquette.
* Demonstrate confidence, strong negotiation capabilities, commercial awareness, and sound decision-making.
* Conduct regular departmental performance meetings and ensure effective team coordination.
* Develop employees through training, mentoring, and practical operational guidance.
* Demonstrate leadership through ownership, discipline, accountability, and consistent performance.
* Act as the primary escalation point for air freight operational and pricing matters.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **8–10 years of relevant experience** in air freight forwarding, operations, and pricing, preferably within the UAE market.
* At least 3–5 years in a managerial or senior leadership position.
* Established professional relationships with airlines, GSAs, and air cargo handling agents in the UAE.
* Strong expertise in transshipment operations, Dubai air cargo facilities, CMC-related opportunities, and cargo handling procedures.
* Excellent knowledge of import, export, transit cargo, customs procedures, AWB documentation, and airline regulations.
* Working knowledge of IATA regulations, dangerous goods procedures, and international freight forwarding practices.
* Proven ability to negotiate competitive airline rates and develop profitable freight solutions.
* Demonstrated experience managing operational teams and improving enquiry conversion rates.
* Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and commercial negotiation skills.
* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
* Professional appearance, leadership presence, and ability to represent the company at senior-level meetings.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver measurable results with minimal supervision.

The successful candidate will be expected to operate with the mindset of a **Department Head and Business Leader**, taking responsibility not only for completing shipments but also for building a highly efficient, profitable, and commercially competitive Air Freight Department.

Management expects someone who can independently identify problems, provide solutions, generate opportunities, develop the team, and deliver measurable improvements in operational performance and profitability.

**We are looking for a strong, decisive, hands-on leader who takes complete ownership of the department, builds lasting airline relationships, drives business growth, and is accountable for results.**

Title: Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.

If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

‎

IMCO’s actively managed Global Credit strategy (~$10.1B AUM) delivers higher risk-adjusted returns through a unified approach to credit investing, integrating public and private credit within a single, globally diversified portfolio. The strategy adopts a holistic approach to portfolio construction, allocating across public credit segments, including investment grade, high yield, leveraged loans, and structured credit, alongside private credit segments to capture relative value opportunities, enhance diversification, and optimize liquidity and return outcomes across market cycles.

Our collaborative culture and value-add approach to strategic partnerships makes us a preferred partner to some of the largest investors in the world. We have a targeted strategy to grow our highly diversified Global Credit portfolio and are looking for a highly motivated Associate Portfolio Manager to join our Global Credit team with a focus on public credit!

The Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit will play a key role in managing IMCO’s externally managed Public Credit portfolio, with responsibilities spanning manager selection and due diligence, portfolio strategy and construction, and ongoing monitoring and oversight. The role combines rigorous investment analysis with active portfolio management, while also contributing to ongoing initiatives to enhance the Global Credit platform and target operating model, including the implementation of investment systems and processes and the development of advanced analytics and AI capabilities to improve portfolio insights and support investment decision-making.

**As a Member of Our Global Credit Team, You Will Contribute Across Three Core Areas: Manager Selection & Oversight, Portfolio Management and Strategy, and Platform Enhancement:**

* Provide analytical and portfolio management support to the Managing Director in overseeing externally managed public credit portfolios on a day-to-day basis, including ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
* Source, screen, and conduct due diligence on external public credit managers across strategies (e.g., investment grade, high yield, loans and structured credit), utilizing data platforms and AI-enabled tools to analyze performance, identify risks, and support manager screening and ongoing evaluation.
* Lead and support the preparation of investment recommendations, including drafting investment memos and presentations for internal Investment Committee approval.
* Assist in structuring and negotiating investment mandates, guidelines, and negotiating fee arrangements with external managers in collaboration with risk, legal and other internal teams.
* Conduct ongoing monitoring of external managers, including performance attribution, risk exposures, style drift, and adherence to investment guidelines; leverage AI to enhance efficiency in analysis, identify performance and risk trends, and support the development of portfolio-level reporting and insights for senior management.
* Lead or contribute to initiatives within Global Credit to enhance portfolio management infrastructure through the application of AI and the integration of new investment systems and analytics capabilities; partner with internal teams (Risk, Performance, Operations, Technology) to improve investment data quality to enable more effective analysis, reporting, and decision-making.
* Support portfolio construction and strategic asset allocation across public credit, including contributing to capital allocation decisions across segments and managers, and shaping overall portfolio strategy.
* Maintain a strong understanding of global public credit markets, including macroeconomic trends, interest rates, credit spreads, and technical factors, to inform manager selection and portfolio positioning.
* Engage regularly with external managers through diligence meetings, portfolio reviews, and on-site visits to assess portfolio strategy, market outlook, and execution capabilities.

Description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**CVS Health | MinuteClinic Product Engineering**

**Primary Job Duties & Responsibilities**

Lead the MinuteClinic Product Engineering team in building software that helps people access care at CVS MinuteClinic, part of a household name in U.S. healthcare. Your team’s work shapes patient access, provider efficiency, and reliable care experiences across patient-facing kiosks, internal applications, APIs, and provider tools.

Take ownership of the next phase of an engineering transformation already delivering results. We have modernized critical systems and shipped AI features that providers use. This role offers the opportunity to develop a strong engineering team, shape the platform’s technical direction, and expand cloud-native and AI capabilities with direct patient and provider impact.

**This is a highly hands-on engineering leadership role.** Stay technically engaged through architecture, code reviews, focused prototyping, and complex production investigations. Contribute code where your involvement removes a critical obstacle, and use that work to strengthen the team’s ability to deliver independently. Technical depth, sound judgment, and a sustained commitment to continuous learning are central expectations.

**Own engineering priorities and outcomes.** Own the team’s engineering roadmap, technical priorities, and delivery commitments in partnership with product and technical leads. Translate business goals into a focused plan, make tradeoffs explicit, and balance product delivery with

reliability, technical debt, and team development. Define measurable outcomes for each initiative, including patient or provider value, production performance, and operational readiness.

**Establish clear ownership and enable independent execution.** Build a team that practices single-threaded ownership, with individual engineers accountable for defined services, features, or workflows from problem definition through production. Give engineers decision-making authority

appropriate to their scope, clarify expectations, remove blockers, and coach them to resolve dependencies and deliver independently. Remain accountable for team outcomes while developing engineers’ judgment and ownership.

**Set technical direction through deep distributed-systems expertise.** Bring hands-on experience designing, building, and operating critical systems under real production traffic and failure conditions. Partner with Staff Engineers and technical leads to make sound decisions about service boundaries, consistency, asynchronous processing, fault isolation, recovery, and scale. Apply architectural discipline informed by practices such as the AWS Well-Architected Framework, and validate decisions through testing and production evidence.

**Drive cloud-native modernization.** Build on progress across patient-facing kiosks, internal web applications, and APIs. Guide the evolution of the current C#, .NET, and Microsoft environment toward cloud-native architectures and open-source technologies, including Python, Java, Kotlin, Kubernetes, and Kafka. Choose technologies based on the problem, evaluate migration risks, and deliver incremental improvements while preserving dependable patient and provider experiences  
  
**Advance practical AI and agentic capabilities.** Expand on AI features already used by providers. Partner with product and clinical stakeholders to identify valuable applications, define success measures, and deliver AI systems and agents that interact with enterprise data and approved tools. Personally experiment with models, tools, and orchestration approaches to understand their capabilities and limitations. Establish evaluation and operational practices that address quality, privacy, security, human oversight, reliability, latency, and cost.

**Make production reliability measurable.** Define service-level indicators and objectives that reflect patient and provider needs. Use operational data and error budgets to guide priorities, and validate resilience through load testing, failure testing, and recovery exercises. Strengthen

observability, automated testing, CI/CD, safe deployments, and incident response. Work alongside engineers on complex failures and ensure corrective actions lead to sustained improvements.

**Build productive cross-functional partnerships.** Work with product managers, clinical stakeholders, security, infrastructure, and other engineering teams to align priorities and manage dependencies. Communicate decisions, progress, tradeoffs, and risks clearly. Resolve conflicts and keep teams focused on shared patient and provider outcomes.

**Hire, coach, and develop strong engineers.**
  
Set clear performance expectations, provide actionable feedback, conduct performance reviews, and support career growth. Develop engineers who can independently own increasingly complex work. Build a collaborative environment where people take initiative, raise concerns early, challenge assumptions constructively, and share accountability for quality.

**Continuously learn and lead by example.** Keep developing your own technical skills through experimentation, feedback, and direct engagement with engineering problems. Apply new knowledge to production work as distributed systems, cloud-native engineering, and AI evolve. Create opportunities for the team to learn, share findings, and put new skills into practice. Treat stronger engineering judgment, broader ownership, and timely escalation of risks as evidence of the team’s growth.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years if relevant experience, including 2+ years experience of leading projects or managing directs
* Proficiency with at least one of the following programming languages: C++, C#, Java, Golang, Javascript, Typescript, Python or similar.
* Strong experience with distributed systems design, implementation and operation at scale.
* Hands-on experience building AI tools, agents, or frameworks through professional, personal, or open-source projects

* Adept at execution and delivery (planning, delivering, and supporting) skills
* Adept at business intelligence
* Adept at collaboration and teamwork
* Mastery of problem solving and decision making skills
* Mastery of growth mindset (agility and developing yourself and others) skills

Title: Senior Manager, Digital Health & Technology (Healthcare Sector Exp) 50013026
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Manager of Digital Health & Technology leads the definition, prioritisation and delivery readiness of QHC's healthcare digital, data and technology requirements. The role translates clinical, operational and corporate priorities into clear technology requirements, delivery roadmaps, information flows and reporting needs, while coordinating with QIC / QTech on solution design, architecture alignment, implementation planning and service readiness.
  
  
In a healthcare startup, technology is a critical enabler of clinical operations, reporting, integration and patient experience. The role supports prioritization of the systems required across Sports Medicine, Citywide Healthcare and IHN, and tracks technology dependencies, delivery risks and readiness requirements. Specifically, within Sport Medicine / Performance , technology is core infrastructure rather than a support afterthought: electronic health records, clinical and athlete-monitoring platforms, analytics and cybersecurity must be specified, procured, deployed and integrated to enable safe clinical delivery and evidence-based performance health.
  
  
The role works closely with clinical, operations, finance and enabling teams to translate business and clinical needs into healthcare technology and data requirements, coordinating with function owners and QTech to ensure solutions are aligned with healthcare requirements and that data is usable for decision-making. The role also supports technology quality assurance, readiness and compliance with relevant healthcare-specific technology and data requirements.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Digital Health Strategy & Technology Requirements
* Implement approved QHC Digital Blueprint and define QHC's health technology requirements and digital roadmap across clinical, operational and enabling domains, aligned with the organization's startup priorities and target operating model
* Translate clinical and business needs into technology specifications, architecture principles and a prioritized delivery plan
* Advise leadership on build-versus-leverage decisions across the QIC / QTech and partner ecosystem
* Coordinate with QTech and relevant function owners on interoperability and integration requirements across clinical, operational and administrative systems
* Data Management, Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Define QHC's healthcare data requirements, information flows, data ownership and reporting needs across functions
* Define and coordinate analytics and reporting requirements that support data-driven clinical, operational and leadership decision-making
* Track data availability, quality, ownership and reporting gaps, coordinating with function owners to ensure healthcare data is usable for decision-making
* Support reporting and data needs across the organization as capability matures
* QTech / QIC SLA & Vendor Service Delivery
* Define, establish and manage service-level agreements with QIC / QTech and technology partners, ensuring strong, accountable service delivery to QHC
* Monitor vendor and partner performance against SLAs and drive remediation where service falls short
* Act as the primary QHC coordination point with QTech and relevant technology stakeholders on healthcare-specific technology requirements and delivery priorities
* Cybersecurity, Data Privacy & Governance
* In coordination with QIC, embed cybersecurity, data privacy and information-governance controls across all platforms and data flows from the outset
* In coordination with QIC, ensure compliance with Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulations and applicable international standards
* In coordination with QIC, establish access controls, audit trails and incident-response readiness for health and personal data
* Deployment, Integration & Readiness
* Oversee deployment and integration readiness for all technology, ensuring systems are tested, secure and operational ahead of go-live milestones
* Coordinate healthcare-specific testing and readiness activities with QTech and relevant clinical and operational teams
* Track technology readiness against the enterprise activation roadmap
* Innovation & Digital Enablement
* Identify and introduce digital health innovations — telehealth, remote athlete monitoring, wearables and AI-assisted tools — aligned with partner best practice
* Pilot and scale digital solutions that enhance clinical quality, athlete outcomes and operational efficiency

**Requirements**
**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master's degree and recognized certifications (e.g. health informatics, cybersecurity, TOGAF, ITIL, or vendor platform certifications
  
  
8+ years of progressive experience in digital health, healthcare IT, health informatics or technology delivery, including experience defining healthcare technology requirements, supporting EHR and healthcare platform delivery, and coordinating technology readiness in new or transforming organizations.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing technology vendors and SLAs, data management and analytics, and cybersecurity / data-privacy controls within a healthcare environment. Experience within accredited healthcare institutions (JCI, CBAHI) is an advantage.
  
  
Working knowledge of Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulatory frameworks, and of interoperability and integration across clinical and administrative systems.

This position requires effective project coordination, sound technical judgment, construction management experience, and the ability to work independently with guidance from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, as needed. The successful candidate must be comfortable making timely decisions within established authority, taking ownership of assigned projects, and maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, schedule, and cost.

The CapEx team supports the operating businesses by delivering projects safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to ongoing operations.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage assigned capital projects through the full project lifecycle, from initial concept and feasibility through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, and turnover to Operations.
* Work with Operations and other stakeholders to define project requirements, evaluate alternatives, develop practical solutions, and establish project scope, budget, schedule, and execution strategy.
* Manage internal and external engineering resources through conceptual, preliminary, and final engineering, including layouts, technical specifications, equipment requirements, constructability reviews, and design coordination.
* Develop and manage project execution plans, schedules, budgets, cost controls, forecasts, contingencies, change management, construction sequencing, and project risk, with input on contracting strategy from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, and Procurement.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, monitor key milestones and critical path activities, and implement mitigation or recovery plans when required.
* Develop technical documentation for equipment and construction procurement, including equipment data sheets, technical specifications, scopes of work, RFPs, and tender packages.
* Coordinate technical evaluations with engineering and Operations and support the selection and procurement of mechanical and process equipment, contractors, consultants, and other project services.
* Manage tendering and contract award activities in collaboration with Procurement, including bidder clarifications, scope alignment, technical evaluations, and recommendations for award.
* Manage construction activities for assigned projects following contract award, coordinating contractors, consultants, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure safe and effective project execution.
* Champion a strong safety culture throughout project development and execution, ensuring safety is incorporated into design, planning, contractor selection, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
* Ensure compliance with applicable health and safety, environmental, regulatory, permitting, engineering, and company requirements.
* Take ownership of project issues, evaluate alternatives, and make timely decisions within established authority, seeking technical or management input and escalating matters when appropriate.
* Proactively manage project performance and risks related to safety, cost, schedule, quality, constructability, procurement, and operational integration, and provide clear reporting to management on project status and key decisions.
* Coordinate commissioning, startup, training, documentation, and turnover to ensure projects are successfully transitioned to Operations, and maintain complete and accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  

**AUTHORITY/DECISION MAKING:**

The Corporate Project Manager manages assigned projects within established company policies, project governance, approved budgets, and delegated authority, with guidance from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, as needed. The position is responsible for day-to-day project decisions related to engineering, procurement, contractor management, construction execution, schedule, cost, and project priorities. The successful candidate is expected to resolve routine project issues and bring forward recommendations on matters requiring leadership or stakeholder approval, including significant changes to scope, budget, schedule, or risk.

  

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Corporate Project Manager coordinates and provides day-to-day project direction to multidisciplinary teams, including internal resources, engineering consultants, contractors, equipment suppliers, and other project partners. The role works with functional leaders to align resources, clarify responsibilities, and support delivery of assigned projects.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

**Education/Experience Requirements:**

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* Experience managing capital projects in heavy industrial, manufacturing, cement, mining, aggregates, materials handling, or similar environments.
* Practical experience across project lifecycle phases, including project development, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
* Experience with industrial construction, contractor coordination, equipment procurement, cost control, scheduling, and project execution.

**Job Knowledge:**

* Working knowledge of industrial project development and construction practices.
* Knowledge of mechanical and process equipment, industrial facilities, and general construction methods.
* Working knowledge of project controls, including budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, change management, and risk management.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, contracts, and construction documents.
* Understanding of contractor and equipment procurement processes.

**Language Skills:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, specifications, contracts, and governmental regulations. Ability to prepare clear reports, business correspondence, scopes of work, and project documentation, and to communicate effectively with employees, contractors, suppliers, consultants, and management.

**Computer Skills:**

* Proficiency with standard Microsoft Office applications and project management/scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project.
* Experience with project controls, document management, and construction management systems.
* Experience with Procore is considered an asset.

**Soft Skills:**

* Effective project leadership, coordination, and communication skills.
* High degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to work independently within established priorities and authority, and to recognize when guidance or escalation is needed.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced project environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with Operations, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and senior management.
  

**OTHER REQUIREMENTS:**

**Travel Requirement:**

Regular travel is an important part of the role and will include visits to company facilities and the company’s head offices in Toronto. Travel frequency will vary depending on project needs and will typically consist of short-duration trips scheduled around key project activities.

The role is not intended to require extended assignments away from the employee’s home location. Travel will generally support project development, construction activities, meetings, commissioning, and other project needs rather than prolonged stays of several weeks or months.

**Physical Demands:**

When visiting project or construction sites, the employee may be required to walk through active industrial environments and use appropriate personal protective equipment.

**Work Environment:**

This position is primarily performed in an office or remote-work environment. The role also includes periodic travel to company facilities and active project or construction sites.

Site visits may involve exposure to typical industrial and construction conditions, including noise, dust, outdoor weather conditions, moving equipment, and areas requiring personal protective equipment.

Title: Head of Software Architecture
Description:
**ABOUT POWER FACTORS**

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.\*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Power Factors is scaling in complexity — more products, more platforms, more sophisticated buyers, and rapidly rising expectations for AI-native capability across our renewable energy software suite. In that context, the absence of a single, accountable technical vision creates real risk: divergent architectural patterns across verticals, inconsistent approaches to AI and data platform investment, and technical debt that compounds faster than it can be paid down.

The Head of Software Architecture exists to close that gap. This is a hands-on, deeply technical leadership role responsible for defining and enforcing enterprise architecture standards across Power Factors' Product & Technology organization — spanning Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, and CAM/FSM/Product Ops — while personally architecting and prototyping the hardest problems the organization faces, particularly around AI-based product introductions, IoT data acquisition, and multi-tenant SaaS scalability.

This role combines the strategic scope of an enterprise architect with the credibility of a builder who still writes code, reviews pull requests, and is comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

### **Purpose of the Role**

The Head of Software Architecture acts to define, evangelize, and enforce a coherent technical architecture strategy that allows Power Factors to scale product complexity without sacrificing reliability, security, or development velocity.

* **Enterprise-wide architectural coherence:** Technical decisions across verticals are grounded in shared architectural principles, not siloed team preferences.
* **AI-native product development:** New AI-based product capabilities are architected end-to-end — from data pipeline to model integration to user-facing experience — rather than bolted on.
* **Development velocity multiplication:** Engineering teams are equipped with modern AI-assisted development tooling and workflows that materially increase throughput.
* **Deep technical credibility:** Engineering leaders and individual contributors alike see this role as a working architect, not a slide-deck strategist.
* **Domain-informed design:** Architecture decisions reflect genuine understanding of renewable energy operations — SCADA, EMS, PPC, edge devices, and grid-facing data systems.

This role acts as the connective tissue between the CPTO's organizational strategy and the day-to-day technical decisions made by vertical engineering teams.

### **Core Responsibilities**

### **1. Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design**

* Define and maintain Power Factors' enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and technical guardrails across all verticals
* Lead architectural reviews for major initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability
* Own the technical roadmap for cross-cutting platform capabilities (data platform, integration layer, identity, observability)
* Design for complex, high-availability systems where correctness, latency, and data integrity carry real operational and commercial consequences
* Partner with vertical leaders (SCADA, EMS, APM, Platform, CloudOps) to ensure local architecture decisions align with enterprise direction

### **2. Technical Team Leadership**

* Build and lead a distributed architecture function that operates as a trusted technical authority across Greece, Montreal, and other regions
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders on architectural judgment, system design, and technical tradeoff analysis
* Establish and run architecture governance forums (design reviews, RFC processes, technical steering committees)
* Act as a technical escalation point for the highest-stakes design decisions across the organization

### **3. AI-Based Product Architecture & Delivery**

* Architect and personally help build end-to-end AI-based product capabilities — from data acquisition and model selection through deployment and monitoring
* Define Power Factors' architectural approach to LLM-based products, including use of Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval architectures, and agentic workflows
* Evaluate and select development LLMs and AI platforms appropriate for embedding into commercial products
* Own the technical bridge between REMI and other AI-native initiatives and the broader platform architecture
* Bring machine learning and data science expertise to bear on product decisions — model selection, feature engineering, data pipeline design, and MLOps practices

### **4. Hands-On Development**

* Write production code, prototype new architectural patterns, and directly contribute to the hardest technical problems facing the organization
* Lead by example on code quality, testing discipline, and engineering craftsmanship
* Stay close enough to the codebase to make credible, current architectural judgments rather than relying on secondhand reporting
* Build proof-of-concept implementations to de-risk major architectural bets before full team investment

### **5. IoT, Edge, and Industrial Systems Architecture**

* Architect scalable IoT data acquisition systems capable of ingesting, normalizing, and processing high-volume telemetry from distributed renewable energy assets
* Design architecture for edge devices and Power Plant Controllers (PPC), balancing on-site computation, latency constraints, and cloud connectivity
* Ensure architectural approaches account for grid code compliance, real-time control requirements, and the operational realities of SCADA and EMS environments
* Apply renewables and energy industry domain knowledge to inform data model, integration, and control system design decisions

### **6. Cloud, SaaS, and Multi-Tenant Architecture**

* Own cloud architecture strategy across GCP and/or AWS, including cost, resilience, and security posture
* Advance Power Factors' multi-tenant SaaS architecture to support scale, tenant isolation, and configurability without fragmenting the codebase
* Define architectural standards for mobile app development where products extend to field and operations use cases
* Evaluate build-vs-buy and platform consolidation decisions across the technology stack

### **7. Engineering Productivity & AI-Enabled Development**

* Identify, evaluate, and roll out AI development tools that enable a 3–4x productivity improvement across engineering teams
* Define best practices for AI-assisted coding, testing, and code review, balancing speed with quality and security
* Partner with engineering leadership to measure and report on productivity gains from AI tooling adoption

### **Reporting & Operating Model**

### **Reporting Line**

* Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO)

Embedded collaboration with:

* Vertical engineering leaders (Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, CAM/FSM/Product Ops)
* Product Management and Product Marketing on AI-based product introductions
* CloudOps and Security on infrastructure and compliance posture

### **Operating Principles**

* Architecture in service of the business, not architecture for its own sake
* Hands-on credibility over theoretical authority
* Pragmatic standardization — enough consistency to scale, not so much it stifles teams
* AI-first thinking applied responsibly, with attention to data quality, safety, and reliability

### **Skills & Profile**

### **Required Experience**

* **15–20 years** of progressive experience in software engineering, with significant time spent in architecture and technical leadership roles
* **Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design:** demonstrated experience architecting large-scale, high-complexity systems with significant operational stakes
* **Technical Team Leadership:** proven ability to lead and mentor senior engineers and architects across distributed teams
* **Trading/Transactional Systems:** experience building high-throughput, high-integrity trading or transactional systems where correctness and performance are non-negotiable
* **AI Product Delivery:** track record architecting and shipping end-to-end AI-based product introductions, from concept to production launch
* **Hands-On Development:** an architect who still codes — genuinely enjoys building, not just designing
* **IoT Data Acquisition:** experience with systems that ingest and process high-volume telemetry from distributed physical assets
* **Edge Devices & Power Plant Controllers (PPC):** familiarity with edge computing architectures and industrial control systems
* **Renewables / Energy Industry Experience:** ideally direct experience in renewable energy or broader energy sector software (strongly preferred, not required)
* **Machine Learning & Data Science:** solid working knowledge sufficient to make informed architectural and platform decisions
* **MCP & LLM-Based Products:** hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol, development LLMs, and building LLM-based product features
* **Cloud Platforms:** deep experience with GCP and/or AWS at an architectural level
* **AI Development Tooling:** experience selecting and rolling out AI dev tools that meaningfully increase engineering team productivity
* **SaaS & Multi-Tenant Architecture:** advanced experience designing and scaling multi-tenant SaaS applications
* **Mobile App Development:** working knowledge of mobile architecture and delivery, sufficient to guide teams building mobile experiences

### **Core Capabilities**

* Strong systems thinking with the ability to zoom between enterprise strategy and line-level code
* Executive-level communication — able to translate architectural tradeoffs into business terms for the CPTO and executive team
* Comfortable operating with significant technical authority while remaining collaborative and low-ego
* Genuine enthusiasm for staying current with the fast-moving AI and LLM landscape

### **Background Fit**

* Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Engineering, or Chief Architect background
* Experience operating in a scaling, multi-product SaaS organization
* Comfortable being both the enterprise architecture authority and an individual contributor when the problem demands it

### **Success Metrics (KPIs)**

* Number of AI-based product capabilities architected and shipped to production per year
* Measured productivity gains (velocity, cycle time) attributable to AI development tooling rollout
* Reduction in cross-vertical architectural inconsistency and duplicated platform investment
* System reliability and performance metrics for enterprise-critical and transactional systems
* Adoption rate of architectural standards and reference designs across engineering teams
* Qualitative 360° feedback from engineering leaders on technical leadership effectiveness

### **What This Role Is Not**

This role is not a purely strategic or advisory position removed from the codebase, and it is not a people-management role focused primarily on process and reporting. The Head of Software Architecture is expected to remain a credible, hands-on technical contributor throughout their tenure.

The role also does not own product roadmap prioritization or commercial strategy — those remain with Product Management and the CPTO — but it directly shapes what is technically possible and how quickly it can be delivered.

**LIFE @ POWER FACTORS**

We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan.

**WHY JOIN US**

By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

**WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status

The role requires a hands-on operational leader capable of managing large teams, resolving operational issues, maintaining quality standards, supporting Government stakeholders, and driving continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced records management and production environment.

***This position is in support of a contract on which we are bidding. Any offers will be contingent on contract award.***

**Operational Leadership**

* Ensure all contract requirements, production targets, timeliness requirements, and performance standards are achieved.

* Minimum **three (3) years of project, operations, site, production, or program management experience** within the last five (5) years.

Title: Director, Project Management
Description:
**About SH/FT**

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

**The Role**

Reporting to COO/CFO, the Director, Project Management leads Shift Paradigm's Project Management practice. They also own the delivery operations that keep the business running: resourcing, forecasting, tooling and process.

This role leads a combined team of Strategic Project Managers and Technical Project Managers across campaign delivery, web development, CMS migration, martech implementation and managed-services engagements. It protects both client outcomes and company margin.

You will set the standard for how work is scoped, planned, resourced and delivered at Shift. In practice, PMs "manage the micro with a macro mindset." They are the single point of contact for delivery teams, the early warning system for risk and scope creep, and the owners of financial accuracy on their engagements.

You will be a trusted partner to Client Partners, Department Heads, Finance and executive leadership. You will be the escalation point when delivery gets hard.

**What You'll Accomplish**
--------------------------

**Practice Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Project Managers at various levels of seniority and with expertise areas. You will own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career pathing and day-to-day escalations.
* Define clear roles and responsibilities between PM, Client Partner and delivery leads, and reinforce them across the organization.
* Build team rituals that keep the practice connected and accountable while working remotely.

**Delivery Excellence & Margin Protection**

* Oversee delivery health across the portfolio: scope, timeline, budget burn, risk and client satisfaction.
* Hold PMs accountable for accurate data, written client approvals and clean change control. These are the basis of margin protection.
* Partner with Client Partners and Finance on monthly reviews, revenue recognition notes, invoice approvals and project/retainer closeouts.
* Step in on high-risk or escalated engagements. Lead recovery plans and hard client conversations when needed.

**Scoping, Pre-Sales & SOW Readiness**

* Bring delivery into the sales cycle. Partner with Client Partners and Department Heads during discovery and scoping so SOWs are realistic and staffable.
* Own and evolve scoping templates and estimation standards. Review SOWs for risk, dependencies, assumptions and timeline feasibility before signature.

**Resource Management & Capacity Planning**

* Oversee the Resource Management function. Direct report: Resource Manager.
* Own the resourcing playbook. It covers resource alerts, pre-resourcing (hiring) triggers, Workfront resource requests and fulfillment.
* Deliver utilization and forecasting insights to leadership. Flag capacity risks early and translate pipeline demand into hiring and contractor recommendations.
* Sponsor skills management and skills-matrix work so staffing decisions are based on real capability data.

**Operations, Tooling & Process Improvement**

* Own Workfront as the system of record for delivery: project templates, timesheets, dashboards, reporting and automation.
* Lead internal operations initiatives such as forecasting dashboards, scope-to-Workfront automation and job aid overhauls. Drive adoption through training and change management.
* Evaluate and introduce new tools, including AI-assisted workflows, that reduce PM administrative load and improve forecasting accuracy.
* Maintain PMO documentation, job aids and standards, and keep them current as the business changes.

**Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership**

* Partner with Client Success, Delivery leadership, Finance and People Ops on operating rhythms, pipeline reviews and planning.
* Present delivery, utilization and margin performance to executive leadership with clear recommendations.

**What You Bring**
------------------

Experience & Expertise

* 10+ years in project, program or delivery management, with 3+ years leading PM teams. Agency or professional services experience required.
* Proven track record delivering web development, CMS migration and/or marketing technology implementations (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Salesforce, Marketo, AEP).
* Deep experience in highly billable environments: scoping, burn tracking, utilization, margin management and revenue forecasting.
* Advanced Workfront experience (or comparable PPM tool), including configuration, reporting and resource management.
* Experience building or running resource management, capacity planning and forecasting processes.
* Track record of operational change: designing processes, building job aids and training, and driving adoption across teams.

Skills & Capabilities

* Experience with Waterfall, Agile/Scrum and hybrid delivery. Experience leading Product Owners or backlog-driven delivery is strongly preferred.
* Executive presence. Able to influence peers and leadership, and to be diplomatic or firm as needed to protect the team and the business.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication with clients, delivery teams and executives.
* Comfort using AI tools to improve team efficiency is a plus.
* PMP, CSM/CSPO or equivalent certification is a plus.

Mindset

* You are a builder. You are comfortable walking into a team that needs structure and creating it rather than waiting for it to arrive.
* You lead through clarity. Colleagues and teammates know where things stand with you. You surface recommendations early and outline the process to bring resolutions to life.
* You are flexible without being formless. You have strong opinions about how good delivery works, and you can adapt how you apply them to different clients, platforms, and team dynamics.
* You do not need a large team or a fully defined playbook to be effective. You are energized by building the thing, not just running it.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact
* Remote flexibility
* Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking
* Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients

**Why SHIFT:**
--------------

SHIFT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SHIFT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

**Comp & Benefits**
-------------------

The salary range for this role is $145,000 to $160,000 USD. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SHIFT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current US or Canada work authorization. For US candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the US.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
145,000 - 160,000 USD per year(Remote)

Title: Director, Practice Operations Quincy and Middleton
Description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.
